```{r}
#Filters out empty prices 
new_data <- listings_Boston[listings_Boston$price!= "", ]
head(new_data)
new_data[new_data$price > 10000, ]
new_data$city <- "Boston"

#Filters out symbols so that price can be a numeric
new_data$price <- gsub("[\\$, ]", "", new_data$price)
new_data$price <- as.numeric(new_data$price)
tax_rate <- 0.1525
new_data$price_with_tax <- new_data$price * (1 + tax_rate)
new_data
```


```{r}
#Makes the amenities a list to work with
new_data$amenities <- gsub("\\[|\\]|\"", "", new_data$amenities)
new_data$amenities <- strsplit(new_data$amenities, ", ")
head(new_data)
#Checks to see in amenities which if the amenities are missing
total_empty <- sum(sapply(new_data$amenities, length) == 0)
total_empty
#Filters out the ones if the amenities are missing
new_data <- new_data %>%
  filter(sapply(amenities, length) > 0)
new_data <- subset(new_data, price <= 1000)
new_data <- subset(new_data, minimum_nights < 120)
#Checks the outliers 
boston_outliers <- new_data[new_data$price >= 750 & new_data$price <= 1000, ]

#Calculates the price per guest for Boston 
new_data$price_per_guest <- new_data$price / new_data$accommodates
new_data$price_per_guest <- as.numeric(new_data$price_per_guest)
```

```{r}

library(dplyr)

new_data$amenities <- gsub("\\[|\\]|\"", "", new_data$amenities)
new_data$amenities <- strsplit(new_data$amenities, ", ")

clean_amenity <- function(x) {
  x <- tolower(x)
  x <- trimws(x)

  x <- gsub("\\\\u2013|–|—", " ", x)
  x <- gsub("\\\\u2019|u2019|u00e9", " ", x)
  x <- gsub("&", "and", x)
  x <- gsub("[[:punct:]]+", " ", x)
  x <- gsub("\\s+", " ", x)
  x <- trimws(x)

  remove_exact <- c(
    "2 5 years old", "5 10 years old", "and 10 years old", "and 5 10 years old",
    "and dresser", "and wardrobe", "every day", "every day available",
    "7 days a week available", "open 24 hours", "open specific hours",
    "monday to friday available", "it varies", "small", "gas",
    "under the counter", "bosch", "integra", "martin logan", "toshiba",
    "disney", "coffee", "dove", "heated", "and", "to"
  )

  if (x %in% remove_exact) return(NA_character_)

  x <- gsub("\\balways at the listing\\b", "", x)
  x <- gsub("\\bavailable upon request\\b", "", x)
  x <- gsub("\\bdepending on availability\\b", "", x)
  x <- gsub("\\bavailable all year\\b", "", x)
  x <- gsub("\\bavailable seasonally\\b", "", x)
  x <- gsub("\\bon property\\b", "", x)
  x <- gsub("\\bnearby\\b", " nearby", x)
  x <- gsub("\\s+", " ", x)
  x <- trimws(x)

  if (grepl("conditioner", x)) return("conditioner")
  if (grepl("body wash|shower gel", x)) return("body wash")
  if (grepl("soap", x)) return("body soap")
  if (grepl("toothpaste", x)) return(NA_character_)

  if (grepl("tv|television|roku|chromecast|premium cable|standard cable|amazon prime video|netflix|hulu|hbo max", x)) return("tv")
  if (grepl("dvd player", x)) return("dvd player")
  if (grepl("board games|arcade games|life size games", x)) return("games")
  if (grepl("game console|ps3|ps4|xbox|nintendo switch", x)) return("game console")
  if (grepl("piano", x)) return("piano")
  if (grepl("record player", x)) return("record player")
  if (grepl("sound system|speaker|alexa|google home|google assistant|bluetooth", x)) return("sound system")

  if (grepl("kitchen", x)) return("kitchen")
  if (grepl("microwave", x)) return("microwave")
  if (grepl("oven", x)) return("oven")
  if (grepl("stove|burners", x)) return("stove")
  if (grepl("refrigerator|fridge", x)) return("refrigerator")
  if (grepl("freezer", x)) return("freezer")
  if (grepl("dishwasher", x)) return("dishwasher")
  if (grepl("coffee maker|french press|pour over coffee|nespresso", x)) return("coffee maker")
  if (grepl("rice maker", x)) return("rice maker")
  if (grepl("bread maker", x)) return("bread maker")
  if (grepl("blender", x)) return("blender")
  if (grepl("toaster", x)) return("toaster")
  if (grepl("baking sheet", x)) return("baking sheet")
  if (grepl("barbecue utensils", x)) return("bbq utensils")
  if (grepl("cooking basics", x)) return("cooking basics")
  if (grepl("dishes and silverware", x)) return("dishes and silverware")
  if (grepl("wine glasses", x)) return("wine glasses")
  if (grepl("dining table", x)) return("dining table")
  if (grepl("breakfast", x)) return("breakfast")

  if (grepl("crib", x)) return("crib")
  if (grepl("high chair|booster seat", x)) return("high chair")
  if (grepl("baby bath", x)) return("baby bath")
  if (grepl("baby monitor", x)) return("baby monitor")
  if (grepl("changing table", x)) return("changing table")
  if (grepl("children s books and toys|books and reading material", x)) return("books and toys")
  if (grepl("children s bikes|bikes", x)) return("bikes")
  if (grepl("children s dinnerware", x)) return("children's dinnerware")
  if (grepl("baby safety gates|outlet covers|table corner guards|window guards", x)) return("child safety features")
  if (grepl("children s playroom|outdoor playground", x)) return("play area")
  if (grepl("babysitter recommendations", x)) return("babysitter recommendations")

  if (grepl("bathtub|bidet", x)) return("bathtub/bidet")
  if (grepl("hair dryer", x)) return("hair dryer")
  if (grepl("shampoo", x)) return("shampoo")
  if (grepl("conditioner", x)) return("conditioner")
  if (grepl("hot water", x)) return("hot water")
  if (grepl("bed linens", x)) return("bed linens")
  if (grepl("extra pillows and blankets", x)) return("extra pillows and blankets")
  if (grepl("hangers", x)) return("hangers")
  if (grepl("closet|wardrobe|clothing storage", x)) return("clothing storage")
  if (grepl("room darkening shades", x)) return("room darkening shades")
  if (grepl("mosquito net", x)) return("mosquito net")
  if (grepl("lock on bedroom door", x)) return("lock on bedroom door")
  if (grepl("private living room", x)) return("private living room")

  if (grepl("air conditioning|ceiling fan|portable fans", x)) return("air conditioning/fan")
  if (grepl("heating|portable heater", x)) return("heating")
  if (grepl("fireplace", x)) return("fireplace")

  if (grepl("washer", x)) return("washer")
  if (grepl("dryer", x)) return("dryer")
  if (grepl("laundromat nearby", x)) return("laundromat nearby")
  if (grepl("cleaning products", x)) return("cleaning products")
  if (grepl("cleaning available during stay|housekeeping", x)) return("housekeeping")

  if (grepl("wifi|ethernet", x)) return("internet")
  if (grepl("self check in|lockbox|smart lock", x)) return("self check-in")
  if (grepl("private entrance", x)) return("private entrance")
  if (grepl("elevator", x)) return("elevator")
  if (grepl("single level home", x)) return("single level home")
  if (grepl("building staff|host greets you", x)) return("host service")
  if (grepl("carbon monoxide alarm", x)) return("carbon monoxide alarm")
  if (grepl("smoke alarm", x)) return("smoke alarm")
  if (grepl("fire extinguisher", x)) return("fire extinguisher")
  if (grepl("first aid kit", x)) return("first aid kit")
  if (grepl("safe", x)) return("safe")
  if (grepl("exterior security cameras|noise decibel monitors", x)) return("security device")

  if (grepl("patio|balcony", x)) return("patio/balcony")
  if (grepl("outdoor dining area|outdoor furniture|sun loungers|hammock", x)) return("outdoor seating")
  if (grepl("bbq grill", x)) return("bbq grill")
  if (grepl("fire pit", x)) return("fire pit")
  if (grepl("hot tub", x)) return("hot tub")
  if (grepl("pool|lap pool", x)) return("pool")
  if (grepl("sauna", x)) return("sauna")
  if (grepl("gym|exercise equipment|free weights|stationary bike|rowing|treadmill|workout bench|yoga mat|elliptical", x)) return("gym/workout equipment")
  if (grepl("ping pong table|pool table", x)) return("game table")
  if (grepl("kayak", x)) return("kayak")
  if (grepl("boat slip", x)) return("boat slip")
  if (grepl("ev charger|tesla only|level 1|level 2", x)) return("ev charger")

  if (grepl("view|waterfront", x)) return("view")

  if (grepl("parking|garage", x)) return("parking")
  if (grepl("pets allowed", x)) return("pets allowed")
  if (grepl("long term stays allowed", x)) return("long term stays allowed")
  if (grepl("luggage dropoff allowed", x)) return("luggage dropoff allowed")
  if (grepl("essentials", x)) return("essentials")
  if (grepl("iron", x)) return("iron")
  if (grepl("bbq utensils", x)) return("bbq utensils")
  if (grepl("smoking allowed", x)) return("smoking allowed")

  remove_patterns <- c(
    "^c ", "^and ", "^there are ", "^varies", "^varied", "^variety",
    "^various", "^usually ", "^liquid ", "^generic ", "^organic ",
    "^eco ", "^premium ", "^private ", "^shared "
  )

  for (pat in remove_patterns) {
    if (grepl(pat, x)) return(NA_character_)
  }

  return(x)
}

new_data$amenities <- lapply(new_data$amenities, function(x) {
  x <- sapply(x, clean_amenity)
  x <- x[!is.na(x) & x != ""]
  unique(x)
})


final_cleanup <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(tolower(x))

  if (x %in% c(
    "100 vegan and cruelty free",
    "7 days a week available at extra cost",
    "every day available at extra cost",
    "monday to friday available at extra cost",
    "gilchrist and soames",
    "nand 5 10 years old",
    "ncoffee",
    "nevery day available at extra cost",
    "and",
    "to"
  )) return(NA_character_)

  if (x %in% c("ac split type ductless system", "window ac unit", "nac split type ductless system")) return("air conditioning/fan")
  if (x %in% c("backyard fully fenced", "nbackyard fully fenced")) return("backyard")
  if (x %in% c("beach access beachfront", "nbeach access beachfront")) return("beach access")
  if (x %in% c("body wash")) return("body soap")
  if (x %in% c("espresso machine", "keurig coffee machine")) return("coffee maker")
  if (x %in% c("free resort access", "nresort access")) return("resort access")
  if (x %in% c("free carport on premises 1 space")) return("parking")
  if (x %in% c("keypad")) return("self check-in")
  if (x %in% c("ndedicated workspace")) return("dedicated workspace")
  if (x %in% c("nlake access")) return("lake access")
  if (x %in% c("nmovie theater")) return("movie theater")
  if (x %in% c("ntrash compactor")) return("trash compactor")

  return(x)
}

new_data$amenities <- lapply(new_data$amenities, function(x) {
  x <- sapply(x, final_cleanup)
  x <- x[!is.na(x) & x != ""]
  unique(x)
})

all_amenities <- sort(unique(unlist(new_data$amenities)))

cat("Total unique cleaned amenities:", length(all_amenities), "\n\n")
print(all_amenities)

amenities_list <- data.frame(Amenity = all_amenities)
write.csv(amenities_list, "final_cleaned_amenities_v3.csv", row.names = FALSE)

amenity_counts <- sort(table(unlist(new_data$amenities)), decreasing = TRUE)
print(amenity_counts)

write.csv(
  data.frame(
    Amenity = names(amenity_counts),
    Count = as.numeric(amenity_counts)
  ),
  "final_cleaned_amenity_counts_v3.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```


```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

amenity_counts <- sort(table(unlist(new_data$amenities)), decreasing = TRUE)

top10 <- data.frame(
  Amenity = names(amenity_counts)[1:10],
  Count = as.numeric(amenity_counts)[1:10]
)

top10$Amenity <- factor(top10$Amenity, levels = rev(top10$Amenity))


ggplot(top10, aes(x = Amenity, y = Count, fill = Amenity)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, show.legend = FALSE) +
  coord_flip() +

  geom_text(
    aes(label = Count),
    hjust = -0.15,
    size = 5,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +

  labs(
    title = "Top 10 Amenities in Boston Airbnb Listings",
    subtitle = "Based on fully cleaned and standardized amenities data",
    x = "",
    y = "Number of Listings"
  ) +

  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "C") +

  expand_limits(y = max(top10$Count) * 1.2) +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13, color = "gray40"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
  )
```

```{r}
clean_amenity <- function(x) {
  x <- tolower(x)
  x <- trimws(x)

  x <- gsub("\\\\u2013|–|—", " ", x)
  x <- gsub("\\\\u2019|\\\\u00e9|u2019|u00e9", " ", x)
  x <- gsub("&", "and", x)
  x <- gsub("[[:punct:]]+", " ", x)
  x <- gsub("\\s+", " ", x)
  x <- trimws(x)

  x <- gsub("\\balways at the listing\\b", "", x)
  x <- gsub("\\bavailable upon request\\b", "", x)
  x <- gsub("\\bdepending on availability\\b", "", x)
  x <- gsub("\\bavailable all year\\b", "", x)
  x <- gsub("\\bavailable seasonally\\b", "", x)
  x <- gsub("\\bavailable at extra cost\\b", "", x)
  x <- gsub("\\bon property\\b", "", x)
  x <- gsub("\\bin building\\b", "", x)
  x <- gsub("\\bin unit\\b", "", x)
  x <- gsub("\\boff premises\\b", "", x)
  x <- gsub("\\bon premises\\b", "", x)
  x <- gsub("\\b1 space\\b|\\b2 spaces\\b|\\b4 spaces\\b", "", x)
  x <- gsub("\\b1 day a week\\b|\\b2 days a week\\b|\\b3 days a week\\b", "", x)
  x <- gsub("\\bmonday\\b|\\btuesday\\b|\\bwednesday\\b|\\bthursday\\b|\\bfriday\\b|\\bsaturday\\b|\\bsunday\\b", "", x)
  x <- gsub("\\bopen 24 hours\\b|\\bopen specific hours\\b", "", x)
  x <- gsub("\\b2 5 years old\\b|\\b5 10 years old\\b|\\b10 years old\\b|\\b10 years old\\b", "", x)
  x <- gsub("\\band 10 years old\\b|\\band 5 10 years old\\b|\\band dresser\\b|\\band wardrobe\\b", "", x)
  x <- gsub("\\bfor ages .*", "", x)
  x <- gsub("\\bfrom .*", "", x)
  x <- gsub("\\s+", " ", x)
  x <- trimws(x)

  remove_exact <- c(
    "", ".", "small", "gas", "electric", "heated", "coffee", "dove",
    "disney", "fire tv", "apple tv", "roku", "netflix", "hulu", "hbo max",
    "amazon prime video", "premium cable", "standard cable",
    "open 24 hours", "open specific hours", "monday", "tuesday",
    "wednesday", "thursday", "friday", "saturday", "sunday",
    "every day", "thursday available at extra cost", "friday available at extra cost",
    "saltwater", "native", "wood burning"

})

  unique(x)
})
```

```{r}
  coord_flip() +
  
  geom_text(
    aes(label = Count),
    hjust = -0.15,
    size = 5,
    fontface = "bold"

  ) +
  
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "C") +

    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
  )
```

```{r}
jersey_step1 <- nrow(jersey_data1)

jersey_step2 <- nrow(jersey_data1)

jersey_data1$price_with_tax <- jersey_data1$price * (1 + jersey_tax_rate)

jersey_data3$price_per_guest <- jersey_data3$price / jersey_data3$accommodates

    "100 vegan and cruelty free",
    "7 days a week available at extra cost",
    "every day available at extra cost",
    "monday to friday available at extra cost",
    "gilchrist and soames",
    "nand 5 10 years old",
    "ncoffee",
    "nevery day available at extra cost",
    "and",
    "to"
  )) return(NA_character_)

  if (x %in% c("ac split type ductless system", "window ac unit", "nac split type ductless system")) return("air conditioning/fan")
  if (x %in% c("backyard fully fenced", "nbackyard fully fenced")) return("backyard")
  if (x %in% c("beach access beachfront", "nbeach access beachfront")) return("beach access")
  if (x %in% c("body wash")) return("body soap")
  if (x %in% c("espresso machine", "keurig coffee machine")) return("coffee maker")
  if (x %in% c("free resort access", "nresort access")) return("resort access")
  if (x %in% c("free carport on premises 1 space")) return("parking")
  if (x %in% c("keypad")) return("self check-in")
  if (x %in% c("ndedicated workspace")) return("dedicated workspace")
  if (x %in% c("nlake access")) return("lake access")
  if (x %in% c("nmovie theater")) return("movie theater")
  if (x %in% c("ntrash compactor")) return("trash compactor")

  return(x)
}

clean_amenity_jersey <- function(x) {
  x <- tolower(x)
  x <- trimws(x)

  x <- gsub("\\\\u2013|–|—", " ", x)
  x <- gsub("\\\\u2019|\\\\u00e9|u2019|u00e9", " ", x)
  x <- gsub("&", "and", x)
  x <- gsub("[[:punct:]]+", " ", x)
  x <- gsub("\\s+", " ", x)
  x <- trimws(x)

  x <- gsub("\\balways at the listing\\b", "", x)
  x <- gsub("\\bavailable upon request\\b", "", x)
  x <- gsub("\\bdepending on availability\\b", "", x)
  x <- gsub("\\bavailable all year\\b", "", x)
  x <- gsub("\\bavailable seasonally\\b", "", x)
  x <- gsub("\\bavailable at extra cost\\b", "", x)
  x <- gsub("\\bon property\\b", "", x)
  x <- gsub("\\bin building\\b", "", x)
  x <- gsub("\\bin unit\\b", "", x)
  x <- gsub("\\boff premises\\b", "", x)
  x <- gsub("\\bon premises\\b", "", x)
  x <- gsub("\\b1 space\\b|\\b2 spaces\\b|\\b4 spaces\\b", "", x)
  x <- gsub("\\b1 day a week\\b|\\b2 days a week\\b|\\b3 days a week\\b", "", x)
  x <- gsub("\\bmonday\\b|\\btuesday\\b|\\bwednesday\\b|\\bthursday\\b|\\bfriday\\b|\\bsaturday\\b|\\bsunday\\b", "", x)
  x <- gsub("\\bopen 24 hours\\b|\\bopen specific hours\\b", "", x)
  x <- gsub("\\b2 5 years old\\b|\\b5 10 years old\\b|\\b10 years old\\b", "", x)
  x <- gsub("\\band 10 years old\\b|\\band 5 10 years old\\b|\\band dresser\\b|\\band wardrobe\\b", "", x)
  x <- gsub("\\bfor ages .*", "", x)
  x <- gsub("\\bfrom .*", "", x)
  x <- gsub("\\s+", " ", x)
  x <- trimws(x)

  remove_exact <- c(
    "", ".", "small", "gas", "electric", "heated", "coffee", "dove",
    "disney", "fire tv", "apple tv", "roku", "netflix", "hulu", "hbo max",
    "amazon prime video", "premium cable", "standard cable",
    "open 24 hours", "open specific hours", "monday", "tuesday",
    "wednesday", "thursday", "friday", "saturday", "sunday",
    "every day", "thursday available at extra cost", "friday available at extra cost",
    "saltwater", "native", "wood burning"
  )
  if (x %in% remove_exact) return(NA_character_)

  x <- gsub("\\b(samsung|lg|bosch|whirlpool|frigidaire|ge|general electric|kitchenaid|kitchen aid|maytag|amana|aeg|avanti|forno|haier|kenmore|jenn air|hotpoint|magic chef|midea|samsung bespoke|fisher paykel|fisher and paykel|bluestar|gourmia|cuisinart|summit|oster|hotpoint|onkyo|sonos|sony|bose|vizio|crosley|echo dot|wonderboom|public goods|aesop|aveda|beekman|bergman kelly|cremo|dial|dr bronner s|ginger lily farms|ginger lilly farms|h20|hotel brand|infuse|molten brown|native|nivea|ogx|olay|pantene|paya|papaya|saltair|satinique|suave|tresemme|tresseme|v05|trader joe s|l or eal|dominican magic avocado|marula soul|g and h organic|silkience|papaya|professional salon quality|salon care|costco carries brands|what is available|various brands|whole foods|365|bath amenity|eco amenities|public good|luxury|regular|standard|generic|organic|basic|different|changes|changes from time to time|one brand|the one available|brand changes|varies|variety|various|available|any|etc)\\b", "", x)
  x <- gsub("\\s+", " ", x)
  x <- trimws(x)

  if (grepl("tv|hdtv|television|roku|chromecast|fire tv|apple tv|netflix|hulu|hbo|max|premium cable|standard cable|disney|dvd player", x)) {
    if (grepl("dvd player", x)) return("dvd player")
    return("tv")
  }
  if (grepl("wifi|fast wifi|ethernet|pocket wifi|mbps", x)) return("internet")
  if (grepl("shampoo", x)) return("shampoo")
  if (grepl("conditioner", x)) return("conditioner")
```

```{r}
prepare_city_data <- function(df, city_name) {
  region_candidates <- c("neighbourhood_cleansed", "neighbourhood", "zipcode")
  region_var <- region_candidates[region_candidates %in% names(df)][1]

  if (length(region_var) == 0 || is.na(region_var)) {
    stop(paste("No valid region field found in", city_name))
  }

  listing_label_var <- if ("name" %in% names(df)) "name" else names(df)[1]

  if (!("amenities_filtered" %in% names(df))) {
    stop(paste("The final filtered amenities column 'amenities_filtered' is missing in", city_name))
  }

  df$latitude <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df$latitude))
  df$longitude <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df$longitude))
  df$price <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df$price))

  if ("accommodates" %in% names(df)) {
    df$accommodates <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df$accommodates))
  }

  out <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(latitude), !is.na(longitude), !is.na(price))

  out[[region_var]] <- as.character(out[[region_var]])
  out[[region_var]][is.na(out[[region_var]]) | trimws(out[[region_var]]) == ""] <- "Unknown"
  out$City <- city_name

  list(
    data = out,
    region_var = region_var,
    listing_label_var = listing_label_var,
    amenity_col = "amenities_filtered"
  )
}

      .sidebar-panel {position: sticky; top: 16px;}
      .theme-panel {border-radius: 28px; padding: 20px; box-shadow: 0 18px 38px rgba(15,23,42,0.12); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.10); backdrop-filter: blur(12px);}
      .content-card {background: rgba(255,255,255,0.95); border-radius: 28px; padding: 20px; box-shadow: 0 18px 38px rgba(15,23,42,0.08); margin-bottom: 18px; border: 1px solid rgba(226,232,240,0.95); backdrop-filter: blur(10px);}
      .preview-card {background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ffffff 0%, #eff6ff 52%, #ecfeff 100%); border-radius: 28px; padding: 20px; box-shadow: 0 18px 38px rgba(37,99,235,0.10); margin-bottom: 18px; border: 1px solid rgba(147,197,253,0.40); position: relative; overflow: hidden;}
      .preview-card:before {content: '✦'; position: absolute; right: 18px; top: 14px; font-size: 22px; color: rgba(37,99,235,0.25);}
      .control-label {font-weight: 700; color: white; font-size: 13px; margin-bottom: 6px;}
      .section-title {font-size: 18px; font-weight: 800; color: inherit; margin-bottom: 12px; letter-spacing: -0.02em; position: relative;}
      .section-subtitle {color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85); font-size: 13px; margin-top: -6px; margin-bottom: 10px; position: relative;}
      .content-card .section-title, .preview-card .section-title {color: #0f172a;}
      .content-card .section-subtitle, .preview-card .section-subtitle {color: #64748b;}
      #map_fallback {border-radius: 22px; overflow: hidden;}
      .hint-text {color: rgba(255,255,255,0.88); font-size: 0.92rem; margin-top: -2px; margin-bottom: 10px; line-height: 1.45; position: relative;}
      .content-card .hint-text, .preview-card .hint-text {color: #64748b;}
      .combo-panel {background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(15,23,42,0.96) 0%, rgba(37,99,235,0.94) 58%, rgba(20,184,166,0.92) 100%); color: white; border-radius: 28px; padding: 22px; box-shadow: 0 18px 38px rgba(37,99,235,0.22); position: relative; overflow: hidden;}
      .combo-panel:before {content: '✧'; position: absolute; right: 18px; top: 14px; font-size: 24px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.22);}
      .combo-title {font-size: 18px; font-weight: 800; margin-bottom: 8px; position: relative;}
      .combo-text {font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; position: relative;}
      .selected-amenities-box {position: relative; margin: 10px 0 12px 0; padding: 12px 14px; border-radius: 16px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.14); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.18); color: white;}
      .selected-amenities-title {font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; opacity: 0.88; margin-bottom: 6px;}
      .selected-amenities-text {font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.5;}
      .stats-ribbon {background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(15,23,42,0.94) 0%, rgba(37,99,235,0.90) 58%, rgba(20,184,166,0.88) 100%); color: white; border-radius: 22px; padding: 14px 18px; box-shadow: 0 12px 24px rgba(15,23,42,0.14); margin-bottom: 14px; display: flex; gap: 14px; justify-content: space-between; flex-wrap: wrap;}
      .stat-chip {display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-width: 160px;}
      .stat-icon {width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 12px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.16); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700;}
      .stat-label {font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; opacity: 0.82;}
      .stat-value {font-size: 18px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.1;}
      .dataTables_wrapper .dataTables_filter {display:none;}
      .btn, .btn-primary {border-radius: 14px !important; font-weight: 700; border: 0;}
      .btn-primary {background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2563eb 0%, #14b8a6 100%) !important; box-shadow: 0 10px 20px rgba(37,99,235,0.2);}
      .btn-primary:hover {filter: brightness(1.03);}
      .bootstrap-select .dropdown-toggle, .form-control, .selectize-input, .irs--shiny {border-radius: 14px !important;}
      .theme-panel .bootstrap-select .dropdown-toggle, .theme-panel .form-control, .theme-panel .selectize-input {border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.18) !important; min-height: 46px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.92) !important; color: #0f172a !important;}
      .content-card .bootstrap-select .dropdown-toggle, .content-card .form-control, .content-card .selectize-input, .preview-card .bootstrap-select .dropdown-toggle, .preview-card .form-control, .preview-card .selectize-input {border: 1px solid #dbe4f0 !important; min-height: 46px;}
      .irs--shiny .irs-bar, .irs--shiny .irs-single, .irs--shiny .irs-from, .irs--shiny .irs-to {background: #2563eb; border-color: #2563eb;}
      .irs--shiny .irs-handle {border-color: #2563eb;}
      .map-note {font-size: 12px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.82); margin-top: 8px;}
      .content-card .map-note, .preview-card .map-note {color: #64748b;}
      .map-focus-note {font-size: 12px; color: #64748b; margin-top: 8px;}
      table {font-size: 14px;}
    "))
  ),

  div(
    class = "app-shell",
    fluidRow(
      column(
        12,
        div(
          class = "hero-wrap",
          div(class = "hero-title", "Student Airbnb Explorer"),
          div(
            class = "hero-subtitle",
            "Explore listings in Boston and Jersey City that meet your preference"
          )
        )
      )
    ),

    sidebarLayout(
      sidebarPanel(
        width = 3,
        div(
          class = "sidebar-panel",
          div(
            class = "theme-panel",
            div(class = "section-title", "Search and filters"),
            div(class = "section-subtitle", "Choose any city, neighborhood, and prefered ameneties from the list below."),
            selectInput(
              "city",
              "Select city",
              choices = c("All Cities", "Boston", "Jersey City"),
              selected = "Boston"
            ),
            div(class = "hint-text", ""),
            uiOutput("region_ui"),
            uiOutput("price_ui"),
            uiOutput("accommodates_ui"),
            uiOutput("amenity_ui"),
            uiOutput("selected_amenities_ui"),
            div(class = "hint-text", "Listings shown will match all selected amenities at the same time."),
            uiOutput("listing_ui")
          )
        )
      ),

      mainPanel(
        width = 9,
        fluidRow(
          column(
            8,
            div(
              class = "theme-panel",
              div(class = "section-title", "Map explorer"),
              uiOutput("map_stats_ui"),
              leafletOutput("map_fallback", height = 560),
              uiOutput("map_note"),
              div(class = "map-focus-note", "Selecting a specific apartment from the dropdown will smoothly zoom the map to that listing.")
            )
          ),
          column(
            4,
            div(class = "combo-panel",
                h4(class = "combo-title", "Selected amenity combination"),
                div(class = "combo-text", textOutput("combo_text"))),
            br(),
            div(class = "theme-panel",
                div(class = "section-title", "Area summary"),
                tableOutput("summary_stats"))
          )
        ),
        fluidRow(
          column(
            6,
            div(
              class = "content-card",
              div(class = "section-title", "Price drivers: accommodation and neighborhood"),
              plotOutput("regression_plot", height = 330),
              div(class = "section-subtitle", "")
            )
          ),
          column(
            6,
            div(
              class = "preview-card",
              div(class = "section-title", "Matching listings preview"),
              div(class = "section-subtitle", ""),
              DTOutput("combo_table")
            )
          )
        ),
        div(class = "content-card",
            div(class = "section-title", "Listings in selected area"),
            DTOutput("listings_table"))
      )
    )
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {

  city_obj <- reactive({
    if (identical(input$city, "All Cities")) return(NULL)
    get_city_obj(input$city)
  })

  city_data <- reactive({
    if (identical(input$city, "All Cities")) {
      common_cols <- intersect(names(boston_obj$data), names(jersey_obj$data))

      all_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(
        boston_obj$data[, common_cols, drop = FALSE],
        jersey_obj$data[, common_cols, drop = FALSE]
      )

      all_df$region_current <- dplyr::coalesce(
        if ("neighbourhood_cleansed" %in% names(all_df)) as.character(all_df$neighbourhood_cleansed) else rep(NA_character_, nrow(all_df)),
        if ("neighbourhood" %in% names(all_df)) as.character(all_df$neighbourhood) else rep(NA_character_, nrow(all_df)),
        if ("zipcode" %in% names(all_df)) as.character(all_df$zipcode) else rep(NA_character_, nrow(all_df))
      )

      all_df$region_current[is.na(all_df$region_current) | trimws(all_df$region_current) == ""] <- "Unknown"
      return(all_df)
    }

    city_obj()$data
  })

  listing_label_var_current <- reactive({
    if (identical(input$city, "All Cities")) {
      if ("name" %in% names(city_data())) return("name")
      return(names(city_data())[1])
    }
    city_obj()$listing_label_var
  })

  region_var_current <- reactive({
    if (identical(input$city, "All Cities")) return("region_current")
    city_obj()$region_var
  })

  amenity_col_current <- reactive({
    "amenities_filtered"
  })

  output$region_ui <- renderUI({
    df <- city_data()
    region_var <- region_var_current()

    choices <- sort(unique(as.character(df[[region_var]])))
    choices <- choices[!is.na(choices) & trimws(choices) != ""]
    choices <- c("All Neighborhoods", choices)

    selectizeInput(
      "region",
      "Type or select neighborhood",
      choices = choices,
      selected = "All Neighborhoods",
      multiple = FALSE,
      options = list(
        placeholder = "Type or select a neighborhood",
        maxOptions = 1000,
        create = FALSE,
        openOnFocus = TRUE,
        closeAfterSelect = TRUE,
        selectOnTab = TRUE
      )
    )
  })

  output$price_ui <- renderUI({
    sliderInput(
      "price_range",
      "Price range",
      min = 0,
      max = 1000,
      value = c(0, 1000),
      step = 1,
      pre = "$"
    )
  })

  output$accommodates_ui <- renderUI({
    df <- city_data()

    if (!("accommodates" %in% names(df)) || all(is.na(df$accommodates))) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    sliderInput(
      "accommodates_range",
      "Accommodation size",
      min = floor(min(df$accommodates, na.rm = TRUE)),
      max = ceiling(max(df$accommodates, na.rm = TRUE)),
      value = c(
        floor(min(df$accommodates, na.rm = TRUE)),
        ceiling(max(df$accommodates, na.rm = TRUE))
      ),
      step = 1
    )
  })

  output$amenity_ui <- renderUI({
    df <- city_data()
    amenity_col <- amenity_col_current()

    req(amenity_col %in% names(df))

    amenity_list <- as_amenity_list(df[[amenity_col]])
    vals <- sort(unique(unlist(amenity_list)))
    vals <- vals[!is.na(vals) & vals != ""]

    pickerInput(
      "amenity_select",
      "Select amenities",
      choices = vals,
      selected = NULL,
      multiple = TRUE,
      options = list(
        `live-search` = TRUE,
        `actions-box` = TRUE,
        size = 10,
        `selected-text-format` = "count > 3"
      )
    )
  })

  output$selected_amenities_ui <- renderUI({
    selected <- input$amenity_select

    text <- if (is.null(selected) || length(selected) == 0) {
      "No amenities selected yet"
    } else {
      paste(selected, collapse = " • ")
    }

    div(
      class = "selected-amenities-box",
      div(class = "selected-amenities-title", "Selected amenities"),
      div(class = "selected-amenities-text", text)
    )
  })

  filtered_data <- reactive({
    req(input$region, input$price_range)

    df <- city_data()
    amenity_col <- amenity_col_current()

    if (!"region_current" %in% names(df)) {
      region_var <- region_var_current()
      df$region_current <- as.character(df[[region_var]])
    }

    out <- df %>%
      filter(
        price >= input$price_range[1],
        price <= input$price_range[2]
      )

    if (!identical(input$region, "All Neighborhoods")) {
      out <- out %>% filter(region_current == input$region)
    }

    if ("accommodates" %in% names(out) && !is.null(input$accommodates_range)) {
      out <- out %>%
        filter(
          !is.na(accommodates),
          accommodates >= input$accommodates_range[1],
          accommodates <= input$accommodates_range[2]
        )
    }

    if (!is.null(input$amenity_select) && length(input$amenity_select) > 0) {
      amenity_list <- as_amenity_list(out[[amenity_col]])

      keep_idx <- vapply(amenity_list, function(x) {
        x <- x[!is.na(x) & x != ""]
        if (length(x) == 0) return(FALSE)
        all(input$amenity_select %in% x)
      }, logical(1))

      out <- out[keep_idx, , drop = FALSE]
    }

    out
  })

  output$listing_ui <- renderUI({
    df <- filtered_data()
    if (nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)

    listing_label_var <- listing_label_var_current()

    labels <- df[[listing_label_var]]
    labels[is.na(labels) | trimws(labels) == ""] <-
      paste("Listing", seq_len(nrow(df)))[is.na(labels) | trimws(labels) == ""]
    labels <- make.unique(as.character(labels))

    pickerInput(
      "listing_id",
      "Zoom to apartment",
      choices = setNames(seq_len(nrow(df)), labels),
      selected = 1,
      options = list(`live-search` = TRUE, size = 8)
    )
  })

  selected_listing <- reactive({
    df <- filtered_data()
    req(nrow(df) > 0, input$listing_id)
    df[as.integer(input$listing_id), , drop = FALSE]
  })

  output$map_note <- renderUI({
    div(class = "map-note", "Interactive map for the currently matching listings in the selected neighborhood.")
  })

  output$map_stats_ui <- renderUI({
    df <- filtered_data()
    n <- nrow(df)
    avg_price <- safe_mean(df$price)
    min_price <- if (n > 0) min(df$price, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_
    max_price <- if (n > 0) max(df$price, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_

    tags$div(
      class = "stats-ribbon",
      tags$div(class = "stat-chip",
               tags$div(class = "stat-icon", "⌂"),
               tags$div(
                 tags$div(class = "stat-label", "Matching listings"),
                 tags$div(class = "stat-value", n)
               )),
      tags$div(class = "stat-chip",
               tags$div(class = "stat-icon", "∅"),
               tags$div(
                 tags$div(class = "stat-label", "Average price"),
                 tags$div(class = "stat-value", fmt_money(avg_price))
               )),
      tags$div(class = "stat-chip",
               tags$div(class = "stat-icon", "↓"),
               tags$div(
                 tags$div(class = "stat-label", "Min price"),
                 tags$div(class = "stat-value", fmt_money(min_price))
               )),
      tags$div(class = "stat-chip",
               tags$div(class = "stat-icon", "↑"),
               tags$div(
                 tags$div(class = "stat-label", "Max price"),
                 tags$div(class = "stat-value", fmt_money(max_price))
               ))
    )
  })

  output$map_fallback <- renderLeaflet({
    df <- city_data()

    init_zoom <- if (identical(input$city, "All Cities")) 9 else if (identical(input$city, "Boston")) 11 else 12

    leaflet() %>%
      addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.PositronNoLabels) %>%
      addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.PositronOnlyLabels) %>%
      setView(
        lng = mean(df$longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
        lat = mean(df$latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
        zoom = init_zoom
      )
  })

  observe({
    df <- filtered_data()

    if (nrow(df) == 0) {
      leafletProxy("map_fallback") %>% clearMarkers() %>% clearPopups()
      return()
    }

    listing_label_var <- listing_label_var_current()

    labels <- df[[listing_label_var]]
    labels[is.na(labels) | trimws(labels) == ""] <-
      paste("Listing", seq_len(nrow(df)))[is.na(labels) | trimws(labels) == ""]

    popup_region <- if ("region_current" %in% names(df)) df$region_current else rep("Selected neighborhood", nrow(df))

    popup_text <- paste0(
      "<div style='font-family:Inter,sans-serif;padding:4px 2px;'><div style='font-weight:800;font-size:14px;margin-bottom:4px;'>", labels, "</div>",
      "<div><b>City:</b> ", df$City, "</div>",
      "<div><b>Price:</b> $", round(df$price, 2), "</div>",
      if ("accommodates" %in% names(df)) paste0("<div><b>Accommodates:</b> ", df$accommodates, "</div>") else "",
      "<div><b>Neighborhood:</b> ", popup_region, "</div></div>"
    )

    marker_colors <- ifelse(df$City == "Boston", "#2458E6", "#14B8A6")

    leafletProxy("map_fallback") %>%
      clearMarkers() %>%
      clearPopups() %>%
      addCircleMarkers(
        lng = df$longitude,
        lat = df$latitude,
        radius = 7,
        weight = 2,
        stroke = TRUE,
        color = "#ffffff",
        fillOpacity = 0.95,
        fillColor = marker_colors,
        popup = popup_text,
        options = pathOptions(riseOnHover = TRUE)
      ) %>%
      fitBounds(
        lng1 = min(df$longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
        lat1 = min(df$latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
        lng2 = max(df$longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
        lat2 = max(df$latitude, na.rm = TRUE)
      )
  })

  observe({
    if (is.null(input$listing_id)) return()

    sl <- selected_listing()
    req(nrow(sl) == 1)

    listing_label_var <- listing_label_var_current()

    label <- sl[[listing_label_var]][1]
    if (is.na(label) || !nzchar(trimws(label))) label <- "Listing"

    popup_region <- if ("region_current" %in% names(sl)) sl$region_current[1] else "Selected neighborhood"

    popup_text <- paste0(
      "<div style='font-family:Inter,sans-serif;padding:4px 2px;'><div style='font-weight:800;font-size:14px;margin-bottom:4px;'>", label, "</div>",
      "<div><b>City:</b> ", sl$City[1], "</div>",
      "<div><b>Price:</b> $", round(sl$price[1], 2), "</div>",
      if ("accommodates" %in% names(sl)) paste0("<div><b>Accommodates:</b> ", sl$accommodates[1], "</div>") else "",
      "<div><b>Neighborhood:</b> ", popup_region, "</div></div>"
    )

    leafletProxy("map_fallback") %>%
      setView(lng = sl$longitude[1], lat = sl$latitude[1], zoom = 17) %>%
      clearPopups() %>%
      addPopups(lng = sl$longitude[1], lat = sl$latitude[1], popup = popup_text)
  })

  output$combo_text <- renderText({
    combo_text(input$amenity_select)
  })

  output$summary_stats <- renderTable({
    df <- filtered_data()

    if (nrow(df) == 0) {
      return(data.frame(Metric = "No matching listings", Value = "Adjust your amenity or price filters"))
    }

    stats <- data.frame(
      Metric = c("Listings", "Average price", "Median price", "SD price", "Min price", "Max price"),
      Value = c(
        nrow(df),
        round(safe_mean(df$price), 2),
        round(safe_median(df$price), 2),
        round(safe_sd(df$price), 2),
        round(min(df$price, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
        round(max(df$price, na.rm = TRUE), 2)
      )
    )

    if ("accommodates" %in% names(df)) {
      stats <- rbind(
        stats,
        data.frame(
          Metric = c("Average accommodates", "Median accommodates"),
          Value = c(
            round(safe_mean(df$accommodates), 2),
            round(safe_median(df$accommodates), 2)
          )
        )
      )
    }

    stats
  }, bordered = TRUE, striped = TRUE, spacing = "m")

  output$regression_plot <- renderPlot({
    df <- city_data()
    req(nrow(df) > 10, "accommodates" %in% names(df))

    if (!"region_current" %in% names(df)) {
      region_var <- region_var_current()
      df$region_current <- as.character(df[[region_var]])
    }

    model_df <- df %>%
      filter(
        !is.na(price),
        !is.na(accommodates),
        !is.na(region_current)
      ) %>%
      mutate(region_group = region_current)

    req(nrow(model_df) > 10)

    region_counts <- sort(table(model_df$region_group), decreasing = TRUE)
    keep_regions <- names(region_counts)[seq_len(min(6, length(region_counts)))]
    model_df$region_group <- ifelse(model_df$region_group %in% keep_regions, model_df$region_group, "Other")
    model_df$region_group <- factor(model_df$region_group)

    fit <- lm(price ~ accommodates + region_group, data = model_df)

    coef_df <- data.frame(
      term = names(coef(fit)),
      estimate = as.numeric(coef(fit)),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )

    coef_df <- coef_df %>%
      filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
      mutate(
        term = ifelse(term == "accommodates", "Accommodates", gsub("region_group", "Neighborhood: ", term)),
        term = factor(term, levels = rev(term))
      )

    ggplot(coef_df, aes(x = estimate, y = term, fill = estimate > 0)) +
      geom_col(show.legend = FALSE, width = 0.65) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "#94a3b8") +
      labs(
        title = paste("Regression view for", input$city),
        x = "Estimated effect on price",
        y = NULL
      ) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#14B8A6", "FALSE" = "#2563EB")) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
      )
  })

  output$combo_table <- renderDT({
    df <- filtered_data()
    listing_label_var <- listing_label_var_current()
    amenity_col <- amenity_col_current()

    if (nrow(df) == 0) {
      preview_df <- data.frame(Message = "No listings match all selected amenities.")
      return(datatable(preview_df, options = list(dom = "t"), rownames = FALSE))
    }

    amenity_list <- as_amenity_list(df[[amenity_col]])
    df$selected_amenities <- vapply(
      amenity_list,
      function(x) paste(x, collapse = " • "),
      character(1)
    )

    preview_df <- df %>%
      select(any_of(c(
        listing_label_var,
        "City",
        "price",
        "accommodates",
        "region_current",
        "selected_amenities"
      ))) %>%
      head(8)

    datatable(
      preview_df,
      options = list(pageLength = 5, scrollX = TRUE, dom = "t"),
      rownames = FALSE,
      class = "compact stripe hover"
    )
  })

  output$listings_table <- renderDT({
    df <- filtered_data()
    listing_label_var <- listing_label_var_current()
    amenity_col <- amenity_col_current()

    if (nrow(df) == 0) {
      empty_df <- data.frame(Message = "No listings match the current filters.")
      return(datatable(empty_df, options = list(dom = "t"), rownames = FALSE))
    }

    amenity_list <- as_amenity_list(df[[amenity_col]])
    df$selected_amenities <- vapply(
      amenity_list,
      function(x) paste(x, collapse = " • "),
      character(1)
    )

    df <- df %>%
      select(any_of(c(
        listing_label_var,
        "City",
        "region_current",
        "price",
        "accommodates",
        "room_type",
        "selected_amenities"
      )))

    datatable(
      df,
      options = list(pageLength = 6, scrollX = TRUE, dom = "tip"),
      rownames = FALSE,
      class = "compact stripe hover"
    )
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)

```


```{r}
library(shiny)
library(bslib)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
library(tidyr)
library(plotly)
library(DT)
library(sf)
library(scales)
library(htmltools)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(mapgl)


BOSTON_FILE <- "listings_Boston.csv"
JERSEY_FILE <- "listings_Jersey.csv"
MAX_PRICE <- 1000

clean_price <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("[,$ ]", "", x)
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

pick_region_var <- function(df) {
  candidates <- c("neighbourhood_cleansed", "neighbourhood", "zipcode")
  found <- candidates[candidates %in% names(df)]
  if (length(found) == 0) stop("No neighborhood-like column found.")
  found[1]
}

pick_name_var <- function(df) {
  candidates <- c("name", "listing_url", "id")
  found <- candidates[candidates %in% names(df)]
  if (length(found) == 0) names(df)[1] else found[1]
}

safe_num <- function(x) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))

normalize_city_data <- function(df, city_name) {
  region_var <- pick_region_var(df)
  name_var   <- pick_name_var(df)

  if ("price" %in% names(df)) {
    df$price <- clean_price(df$price)
  } else {
    stop(paste("Missing `price` column in", city_name))
  }

  if ("latitude" %in% names(df)) df$latitude <- safe_num(df$latitude)
  if ("longitude" %in% names(df)) df$longitude <- safe_num(df$longitude)
  if ("accommodates" %in% names(df)) df$accommodates <- safe_num(df$accommodates)
  if ("bedrooms" %in% names(df)) df$bedrooms <- safe_num(df$bedrooms)
  if ("beds" %in% names(df)) df$beds <- safe_num(df$beds)

  if ("bathrooms" %in% names(df)) {
    if (is.character(df$bathrooms)) {
      df$bathrooms_num <- readr::parse_number(df$bathrooms)
    } else {
      df$bathrooms_num <- safe_num(df$bathrooms)
    }
  } else {
    df$bathrooms_num <- NA_real_
  }

  if (!("amenities" %in% names(df))) df$amenities <- ""

  df %>%
    mutate(
      city = city_name,
      neighbourhood_key = as.character(.data[[region_var]]),
      listing_label = as.character(.data[[name_var]])
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      neighbourhood_key = ifelse(
        is.na(neighbourhood_key) | trimws(neighbourhood_key) == "",
        "Unknown",
        neighbourhood_key
      ),
      listing_label = ifelse(
        is.na(listing_label) | trimws(listing_label) == "",
        paste("Listing", row_number()),
        listing_label
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(price),
      price > 0,
      price <= MAX_PRICE,
      !is.na(latitude),
      !is.na(longitude)
    )
}

detect_amenity <- function(x, pattern) {
  str_detect(str_to_lower(coalesce(x, "")), pattern)
}

prepare_listing_features <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      has_wifi = detect_amenity(amenities, "wifi|ethernet"),
      has_kitchen = detect_amenity(amenities, "kitchen"),
      has_parking = detect_amenity(amenities, "parking|garage|carport|driveway|street parking"),
      has_ac = detect_amenity(amenities, "air conditioning|ceiling fan|portable fans|window ac|central air"),
      has_pool = detect_amenity(amenities, "pool"),
      has_gym = detect_amenity(amenities, "gym|exercise equipment|free weights|treadmill|yoga"),
      has_tv = detect_amenity(amenities, "tv|television|hdtv|roku|chromecast"),
      has_washer = detect_amenity(amenities, "washer"),
      has_dryer = detect_amenity(amenities, "dryer"),
      has_elevator = detect_amenity(amenities, "elevator"),
      has_workspace = detect_amenity(amenities, "dedicated workspace"),
      has_pets_allowed = detect_amenity(amenities, "pets allowed")
    )
}

aggregate_neighborhoods <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    group_by(city, neighbourhood_key) %>%
    summarise(
      n_listings = n(),
      mean_price = mean(price, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_price = median(price, na.rm = TRUE),
      min_price = min(price, na.rm = TRUE),
      max_price = max(price, na.rm = TRUE),
      q1_price = quantile(price, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
      q3_price = quantile(price, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_price = sd(price, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_accommodates = mean(accommodates, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_bedrooms = mean(bedrooms, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_beds = mean(beds, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_bathrooms = mean(bathrooms_num, na.rm = TRUE),
      wifi_rate = mean(has_wifi, na.rm = TRUE),
      kitchen_rate = mean(has_kitchen, na.rm = TRUE),
      parking_rate = mean(has_parking, na.rm = TRUE),
      ac_rate = mean(has_ac, na.rm = TRUE),
      pool_rate = mean(has_pool, na.rm = TRUE),
      gym_rate = mean(has_gym, na.rm = TRUE),
      tv_rate = mean(has_tv, na.rm = TRUE),
      washer_rate = mean(has_washer, na.rm = TRUE),
      dryer_rate = mean(has_dryer, na.rm = TRUE),
      elevator_rate = mean(has_elevator, na.rm = TRUE),
      workspace_rate = mean(has_workspace, na.rm = TRUE),
      pets_rate = mean(has_pets_allowed, na.rm = TRUE),
      latitude = mean(latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
      longitude = mean(longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~replace_na(., 0)))
}

assign_price_tier <- function(x) {
  u <- unique(na.omit(x))
  if (length(u) < 3) {
    return(factor(rep("Medium", length(x)),
      levels = c("Affordable", "Medium", "Expensive")
    ))
  }

  brks <- unique(as.numeric(quantile(x, probs = c(0, 1/3, 2/3, 1), na.rm = TRUE)))
  if (length(brks) < 4) {
    rk <- rank(x, ties.method = "average")
    grp <- ntile(rk, 3)
    out <- c("Affordable", "Medium", "Expensive")[grp]
    return(factor(out, levels = c("Affordable", "Medium", "Expensive")))
  }

  cut(
    x,
    breaks = brks,
    include.lowest = TRUE,
    labels = c("Affordable", "Medium", "Expensive")
  )
}

cluster_neighborhoods <- function(df, k = 3, price_basis = "median_price") {
  feature_vars <- c(
    "median_price",
    "sd_price",
    "mean_accommodates",
    "wifi_rate",
    "parking_rate",
    "gym_rate",
    "elevator_rate"
  )

  feature_vars <- feature_vars[feature_vars %in% names(df)]
  x <- df[, feature_vars, drop = FALSE]
  x[is.na(x)] <- 0
  x_scaled <- scale(x)

  set.seed(123)
  km <- kmeans(x_scaled, centers = k, nstart = 50)

  df %>%
    mutate(
      cluster_id = km$cluster,
      cluster = paste0("Cluster ", km$cluster),
      price_tier = assign_price_tier(.data[[price_basis]])
    )
}

compute_pca_payload <- function(df) {
  vars <- c(
    "median_price", "sd_price", "mean_accommodates",
    "wifi_rate", "parking_rate", "gym_rate", "elevator_rate"
  )
  vars <- vars[vars %in% names(df)]

  x <- df[, vars, drop = FALSE]
  x <- x[, apply(x, 2, function(col) sd(col, na.rm = TRUE) > 0), drop = FALSE]

  if (ncol(x) < 2) {
    return(list(
      scores = data.frame(),
      loadings = data.frame(),
      variance = c(PC1 = NA_real_, PC2 = NA_real_, PC3 = NA_real_)
    ))
  }

  pca <- prcomp(x, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

  scores <- as.data.frame(pca$x[, seq_len(min(3, ncol(pca$x))), drop = FALSE])
  if (!("PC1" %in% names(scores))) scores$PC1 <- 0
  if (!("PC2" %in% names(scores))) scores$PC2 <- 0
  if (!("PC3" %in% names(scores))) scores$PC3 <- 0

  scores <- scores %>%
    mutate(
      city = df$city,
      neighbourhood_key = df$neighbourhood_key,
      cluster = df$cluster,
      price_tier = df$price_tier,
      median_price = df$median_price,
      n_listings = df$n_listings,
      low_listing_flag = df$low_listing_flag
    )

  loadings <- as.data.frame(pca$rotation[, seq_len(min(3, ncol(pca$rotation))), drop = FALSE])
  if (!("PC1" %in% names(loadings))) loadings$PC1 <- 0
  if (!("PC2" %in% names(loadings))) loadings$PC2 <- 0
  if (!("PC3" %in% names(loadings))) loadings$PC3 <- 0
  loadings$variable <- rownames(loadings)

  imp <- summary(pca)$importance
  variance <- c(
    PC1 = ifelse(ncol(imp) >= 1, imp[2, 1], NA_real_),
    PC2 = ifelse(ncol(imp) >= 2, imp[2, 2], NA_real_),
    PC3 = ifelse(ncol(imp) >= 3, imp[2, 3], NA_real_)
  )

  list(scores = scores, loadings = loadings, variance = variance)
}

make_popup_html <- function(df) {
  warn_line <- ifelse(
    df$low_listing_flag,
    "<div style='color:#92400E; font-weight:700;'>Low listing count: interpret with caution</div>",
    ""
  )

  paste0(
    "<div style='font-family:Inter,Arial,sans-serif;'>",
    "<div style='font-weight:800;font-size:14px;margin-bottom:6px;'>", htmlEscape(df$neighbourhood_key), "</div>",
    "<div><b>City:</b> ", htmlEscape(df$city), "</div>",
    "<div><b>Listings:</b> ", comma(df$n_listings), "</div>",
    "<div><b>Mean price:</b> $", comma(round(df$mean_price, 0)), "</div>",
    "<div><b>Median price:</b> $", comma(round(df$median_price, 0)), "</div>",
    "<div><b>Min:</b> $", comma(round(df$min_price, 0)), "</div>",
    "<div><b>Max:</b> $", comma(round(df$max_price, 0)), "</div>",
    "<div><b>Cluster:</b> ", htmlEscape(df$cluster), "</div>",
    "<div><b>Price tier:</b> ", htmlEscape(as.character(df$price_tier)), "</div>",
    warn_line,
    "</div>"
  )
}

tier_palette <- c(
  "Affordable" = "#10B981",
  "Medium" = "#F59E0B",
  "Expensive" = "#EF4444"
)

cluster_palette <- function(n) {
  cols <- brewer.pal(max(3, min(8, n)), "Set2")
  cols[seq_len(n)]
}


if (!file.exists(BOSTON_FILE)) stop(paste("Missing file:", BOSTON_FILE))
if (!file.exists(JERSEY_FILE)) stop(paste("Missing file:", JERSEY_FILE))

boston_raw <- read_csv(BOSTON_FILE, show_col_types = FALSE)
jersey_raw <- read_csv(JERSEY_FILE, show_col_types = FALSE)

boston <- normalize_city_data(boston_raw, "Boston")
jersey <- normalize_city_data(jersey_raw, "Jersey City")

listings_all <- bind_rows(boston, jersey) %>%
  prepare_listing_features()

neighborhoods_base <- aggregate_neighborhoods(listings_all)

server <- function(input, output, session) {

  clustered_data <- reactive({
    df <- neighborhoods_base

    if (!identical(input$city_filter, "All")) {
      df <- df %>% filter(city == input$city_filter)
    }

    df <- df %>%
      filter(
        n_listings >= input$min_listings,
        median_price >= input$median_range[1],
        median_price <= input$median_range[2]
      )

    if (!is.null(input$neighborhood_select) && length(input$neighborhood_select) > 0) {
      df <- df %>% filter(neighbourhood_key %in% input$neighborhood_select)
    }

    validate(need(nrow(df) >= input$n_clusters, "Not enough neighborhoods for the selected number of clusters."))

    cluster_neighborhoods(
      df = df,
      k = input$n_clusters,
      price_basis = input$price_basis
    )
  })

  pca_payload <- reactive({
    compute_pca_payload(clustered_data())
  })

  listings_filtered <- reactive({
    nhoods <- clustered_data() %>% pull(neighbourhood_key)
    cities <- clustered_data() %>% distinct(city) %>% pull(city)

    listings_all %>%
      filter(
        city %in% cities,
        neighbourhood_key %in% nhoods,
        !is.na(latitude),
        !is.na(longitude)
      )
  })

  output$vb_nhoods <- renderText({
    comma(nrow(clustered_data()))
  })

  output$vb_median <- renderText({
    paste0("$", comma(round(median(clustered_data()$median_price, na.rm = TRUE), 0)))
  })

  output$vb_clusters <- renderText({
    length(unique(clustered_data()$cluster))
  })


  output$price_map <- renderMaplibre({
    neigh_df <- clustered_data()
    list_df  <- listings_filtered()

    validate(need(nrow(list_df) > 0, "No listing locations to map."))

    # attach cluster and tier from neighborhood-level clustering
    list_df <- list_df %>%
      left_join(
        neigh_df %>%
          select(city, neighbourhood_key, cluster, price_tier, median_price),
        by = c("city", "neighbourhood_key")
      )

    list_sf <- st_as_sf(
      list_df,
      coords = c("longitude", "latitude"),
      crs = 4326,
      remove = FALSE
    )

    list_sf$popup_html <- paste0(
      "<div style='font-family:Inter,Arial,sans-serif;'>",
      "<div style='font-weight:800;font-size:14px;margin-bottom:6px;'>", htmlEscape(list_sf$listing_label), "</div>",
      "<div><b>City:</b> ", htmlEscape(list_sf$city), "</div>",
      "<div><b>Neighborhood:</b> ", htmlEscape(list_sf$neighbourhood_key), "</div>",
      "<div><b>Listing price:</b> $", comma(round(list_sf$price, 0)), "</div>",
      if ("accommodates" %in% names(list_sf)) paste0("<div><b>Accommodates:</b> ", list_sf$accommodates, "</div>") else "",
      "<div><b>Neighborhood cluster:</b> ", htmlEscape(list_sf$cluster), "</div>",
      "<div><b>Price tier:</b> ", htmlEscape(as.character(list_sf$price_tier)), "</div>",
      "</div>"
    )

    if (identical(input$color_by, "price_tier")) {
      circle_colors <- mapgl::match_expr(
        "price_tier",
        values = names(tier_palette),
        stops = unname(tier_palette)
      )
      legend_values <- names(tier_palette)
      legend_colors <- unname(tier_palette)
      legend_title <- "Price tier"
    } else {
      clust_vals <- sort(unique(list_sf$cluster))
      clust_cols <- cluster_palette(length(clust_vals))
      circle_colors <- mapgl::match_expr(
        "cluster",
        values = clust_vals,
        stops = clust_cols
      )
      legend_values <- clust_vals
      legend_colors <- clust_cols
      legend_title <- "Cluster"
    }

    # radius based on actual listing price
    rad <- mapgl::interpolate(
      column = "price",
      values = c(min(list_sf$price, na.rm = TRUE), max(list_sf$price, na.rm = TRUE)),
      stops = c(5, 14)
    )

    mapgl::maplibre(
      style = mapgl::carto_style("positron"),
      center = c(mean(list_sf$longitude, na.rm = TRUE), mean(list_sf$latitude, na.rm = TRUE)),
      zoom = ifelse(length(unique(list_sf$city)) == 1, 11, 8)
    ) %>%
      mapgl::add_navigation_control() %>%
      mapgl::add_fullscreen_control() %>%
      mapgl::add_circle_layer(
        id = "listing_points",
        source = list_sf,
        circle_color = circle_colors,
        circle_radius = rad,
        circle_opacity = 0.82,
        circle_stroke_color = "#FFFFFF",
        circle_stroke_width = 1.1,
        popup = "popup_html",
        tooltip = "listing_label",
        hover_options = list(
          circle_radius = 18,
          circle_opacity = 1
        )
      ) %>%
      mapgl::add_categorical_legend(
        legend_title = legend_title,
        values = legend_values,
        colors = legend_colors,
        circular_patches = TRUE
      )
  })

  output$pca_scores <- renderPlotly({
    scores <- pca_payload()$scores

    validate(need(nrow(scores) > 0, "PCA unavailable for the current filter."))

    plot_ly(
      data = scores,
      x = ~PC1,
      y = ~PC2,
      type = "scatter",
      mode = "markers",
      color = ~price_tier,
      colors = tier_palette,
      symbol = ~cluster,
      symbols = c("circle", "square", "diamond", "x", "triangle-up", "cross", "star", "triangle-down"),
      size = ~median_price,
      sizes = c(10, 30),
      text = ~paste0(
        "<b>", neighbourhood_key, "</b>",
        "<br>City: ", city,
        "<br>Median price: $", comma(round(median_price, 0)),
        "<br>Listings: ", comma(n_listings),
        "<br>Cluster: ", cluster,
        "<br>Tier: ", price_tier
      ),
      hovertemplate = "%{text}<br>PC1=%{x:.2f}<br>PC2=%{y:.2f}<extra></extra>"
    ) %>%
      layout(
        title = paste0(
          "PCA scores",
          "<br><sup>Explained variance: PC1 = ",
          percent(pca_payload()$variance["PC1"], accuracy = 0.1),
          ", PC2 = ",
          percent(pca_payload()$variance["PC2"], accuracy = 0.1),
          "</sup>"
        ),
        xaxis = list(title = "PC1"),
        yaxis = list(title = "PC2"),
        legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0, y = -0.15)
      )
  })

  output$pca_loadings <- renderPlotly({
    loadings <- pca_payload()$loadings

    validate(need(nrow(loadings) > 0, "PCA loadings unavailable for the current filter."))

    plot_ly(
      data = loadings,
      x = ~PC1,
      y = ~PC2,
      type = "scatter",
      mode = "markers+text",
      text = ~variable,
      textposition = "top center",
      hovertemplate = paste0(
        "<b>%{text}</b>",
        "<br>PC1 = %{x:.3f}",
        "<br>PC2 = %{y:.3f}<extra></extra>"
      )
    ) %>%
      add_segments(
        x = 0, y = 0,
        xend = ~PC1, yend = ~PC2,
        inherit = FALSE,
        showlegend = FALSE
      ) %>%
      layout(
        title = "PCA loadings",
        xaxis = list(title = "PC1", zeroline = TRUE),
        yaxis = list(title = "PC2", zeroline = TRUE)
      )
  })

  output$summary_table <- renderDT({
    df <- clustered_data() %>%
      mutate(price_tier = as.character(price_tier)) %>%
      select(
        city, neighbourhood_key, n_listings, cluster, price_tier,
        mean_price, median_price, min_price, max_price, q1_price, q3_price, sd_price,
        mean_accommodates, mean_bedrooms, mean_beds, mean_bathrooms,
        wifi_rate, kitchen_rate, parking_rate, ac_rate, pool_rate,
        gym_rate, tv_rate, washer_rate, dryer_rate, elevator_rate,
        workspace_rate, pets_rate
      ) %>%
      arrange(desc(median_price))

    datatable(
      df,
      rownames = FALSE,
      extensions = "Buttons",
      options = list(
        pageLength = 12,
        scrollX = TRUE,
        dom = "Bfrtip",
        buttons = c("copy", "csv", "excel")
      )
    ) %>%
      formatCurrency(c("mean_price", "median_price", "min_price", "max_price", "q1_price", "q3_price"), currency = "$", digits = 0) %>%
      formatRound(c("sd_price", "mean_accommodates", "mean_bedrooms", "mean_beds", "mean_bathrooms"), 2) %>%
      formatPercentage(
        c("wifi_rate", "kitchen_rate", "parking_rate", "ac_rate", "pool_rate",
          "gym_rate", "tv_rate", "washer_rate", "dryer_rate", "elevator_rate",
          "workspace_rate", "pets_rate"), 1
      )
  })

  output$listing_table <- renderDT({
    df <- listings_filtered() %>%
      select(
        city, neighbourhood_key, listing_label, price,
        accommodates, bedrooms, beds, bathrooms_num,
        latitude, longitude
      ) %>%
      arrange(desc(price))

    datatable(
      df,
      rownames = FALSE,
      extensions = "Buttons",
      options = list(
        pageLength = 12,
        scrollX = TRUE,
        dom = "Bfrtip",
        buttons = c("copy", "csv", "excel")
      )
    ) %>%
      formatCurrency("price", currency = "$", digits = 0) %>%
      formatRound(c("bathrooms_num", "latitude", "longitude"), 4)
  })

  output$price_hist <- renderPlotly({
    df <- clustered_data()

    plot_ly(
      data = df,
      x = ~median_price,
      color = ~price_tier,
      colors = tier_palette,
      type = "histogram"
    ) %>%
      layout(
        title = "Distribution of neighborhood median prices",
        xaxis = list(title = "Neighborhood median price"),
        yaxis = list(title = "Count")
      )
  })

  output$cluster_box <- renderPlotly({
    df <- clustered_data()

    plot_ly(
      data = df,
      x = ~cluster,
      y = ~median_price,
      color = ~cluster,
      type = "box",
      boxpoints = "all",
      jitter = 0.2,
      pointpos = 0
    ) %>%
      layout(
        title = "Median price by cluster",
        xaxis = list(title = "Cluster"),
        yaxis = list(title = "Neighborhood median price")
      )
  })

  output$scatter_price <- renderPlotly({
    df <- clustered_data()

    plot_ly(
      data = df,
      x = ~mean_price,
      y = ~median_price,
      color = ~price_tier,
      colors = tier_palette,
      type = "scatter",
      mode = "markers",
      text = ~paste0(
        "<b>", neighbourhood_key, "</b>",
        "<br>City: ", city,
        "<br>Cluster: ", cluster,
        "<br>Mean: $", comma(round(mean_price, 0)),
        "<br>Median: $", comma(round(median_price, 0))
      ),
      hovertemplate = "%{text}<extra></extra>"
    ) %>%
      layout(
        title = "Mean vs median neighborhood price",
        xaxis = list(title = "Mean price"),
        yaxis = list(title = "Median price")
      )
  })

  output$amenity_bars <- renderPlotly({
    df <- clustered_data()

    amenity_df <- df %>%
      summarise(
        WiFi = mean(wifi_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
        Kitchen = mean(kitchen_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
        Parking = mean(parking_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
        AC = mean(ac_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
        Pool = mean(pool_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
        Gym = mean(gym_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
        TV = mean(tv_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
        Washer = mean(washer_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
        Dryer = mean(dryer_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
        Elevator = mean(elevator_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
        Workspace = mean(workspace_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
        Pets = mean(pets_rate, na.rm = TRUE)
      ) %>%
      pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "amenity", values_to = "rate")

    plot_ly(
      data = amenity_df,
      x = ~reorder(amenity, rate),
      y = ~rate,
      type = "bar"
    ) %>%
      layout(
        title = "Average amenity presence across shown neighborhoods",
        xaxis = list(title = ""),
        yaxis = list(title = "Rate", tickformat = ".0%")
      )
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```

```{r}
# Clustering 
# Required packages:
# install.packages(c(
#   "shiny", "bslib", "dplyr", "readr", "stringr", "purrr", "tidyr",
#   "plotly", "DT", "sf", "scales", "mapgl", "htmltools", "RColorBrewer"
# ))

install.packages("Rcpp")
install.packages("mapgl")
library(shiny)
library(bslib)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
library(tidyr)
library(plotly)
library(DT)
library(sf)
library(scales)
library(htmltools)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(mapgl)

BOSTON_FILE <- "listings_Boston.csv"
JERSEY_FILE <- "listings_Jersey.csv"

MAX_PRICE <- 1000

clean_price <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("[,$ ]", "", x)
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

pick_region_var <- function(df) {
  candidates <- c("neighbourhood_cleansed", "neighbourhood", "zipcode")
  found <- candidates[candidates %in% names(df)]
  if (length(found) == 0) stop("No neighborhood-like column found.")
  found[1]
}

pick_name_var <- function(df) {
  candidates <- c("name", "listing_url", "id")
  found <- candidates[candidates %in% names(df)]
  if (length(found) == 0) names(df)[1] else found[1]
}

safe_num <- function(x) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))

normalize_city_data <- function(df, city_name) {
  region_var <- pick_region_var(df)
  name_var   <- pick_name_var(df)

  if ("price" %in% names(df)) {
    df$price <- clean_price(df$price)
  } else {
    stop(paste("Missing `price` column in", city_name))
  }

  if ("latitude" %in% names(df))  df$latitude  <- safe_num(df$latitude)
  if ("longitude" %in% names(df)) df$longitude <- safe_num(df$longitude)
  if ("accommodates" %in% names(df)) df$accommodates <- safe_num(df$accommodates)
  if ("bedrooms" %in% names(df)) df$bedrooms <- safe_num(df$bedrooms)
  if ("beds" %in% names(df)) df$beds <- safe_num(df$beds)

  # bathrooms may be numeric or character like "1 bath"
  if ("bathrooms" %in% names(df)) {
    if (is.character(df$bathrooms)) {
      df$bathrooms_num <- readr::parse_number(df$bathrooms)
    } else {
      df$bathrooms_num <- safe_num(df$bathrooms)
    }
  } else {
    df$bathrooms_num <- NA_real_
  }

  if (!("amenities" %in% names(df))) df$amenities <- ""

  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      city = city_name,
      neighbourhood_key = as.character(.data[[region_var]]),
      listing_label = as.character(.data[[name_var]])
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      neighbourhood_key = ifelse(
        is.na(neighbourhood_key) | trimws(neighbourhood_key) == "",
        "Unknown",
        neighbourhood_key
      ),
      listing_label = ifelse(
        is.na(listing_label) | trimws(listing_label) == "",
        paste("Listing", row_number()),
        listing_label
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(price),
      price > 0,
      price <= MAX_PRICE,
      !is.na(latitude),
      !is.na(longitude)
    )

  df
}

detect_amenity <- function(x, pattern) {
  str_detect(str_to_lower(coalesce(x, "")), pattern)
}

prepare_listing_features <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      has_wifi    = detect_amenity(amenities, "wifi|ethernet"),
      has_kitchen = detect_amenity(amenities, "kitchen"),
      has_parking = detect_amenity(amenities, "parking|garage|carport|driveway|street parking"),
      has_ac      = detect_amenity(amenities, "air conditioning|ceiling fan|portable fans|window ac|central air"),
      has_pool    = detect_amenity(amenities, "pool"),
      has_gym     = detect_amenity(amenities, "gym|exercise equipment|free weights|treadmill|yoga"),
      has_tv      = detect_amenity(amenities, "tv|television|hdtv|roku|chromecast"),
      has_washer  = detect_amenity(amenities, "washer"),
      has_dryer   = detect_amenity(amenities, "dryer"),
      has_elevator = detect_amenity(amenities, "elevator"),
      has_workspace = detect_amenity(amenities, "dedicated workspace"),
      has_pets_allowed = detect_amenity(amenities, "pets allowed")
    )
}

aggregate_neighborhoods <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    group_by(city, neighbourhood_key) %>%
    summarise(
      n_listings = n(),
      mean_price = mean(price, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_price = median(price, na.rm = TRUE),
      min_price = min(price, na.rm = TRUE),
      max_price = max(price, na.rm = TRUE),
      q1_price = quantile(price, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
      q3_price = quantile(price, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_price = sd(price, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_accommodates = mean(accommodates, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_bedrooms = mean(bedrooms, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_beds = mean(beds, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_bathrooms = mean(bathrooms_num, na.rm = TRUE),
      wifi_rate = mean(has_wifi, na.rm = TRUE),
      kitchen_rate = mean(has_kitchen, na.rm = TRUE),
      parking_rate = mean(has_parking, na.rm = TRUE),
      ac_rate = mean(has_ac, na.rm = TRUE),
      pool_rate = mean(has_pool, na.rm = TRUE),
      gym_rate = mean(has_gym, na.rm = TRUE),
      tv_rate = mean(has_tv, na.rm = TRUE),
      washer_rate = mean(has_washer, na.rm = TRUE),
      dryer_rate = mean(has_dryer, na.rm = TRUE),
      elevator_rate = mean(has_elevator, na.rm = TRUE),
      workspace_rate = mean(has_workspace, na.rm = TRUE),
      pets_rate = mean(has_pets_allowed, na.rm = TRUE),
      latitude = mean(latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
      longitude = mean(longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~replace_na(., 0)))
}

assign_price_tier <- function(x) {
  u <- unique(na.omit(x))
  if (length(u) < 3) {
    return(factor(rep("Medium", length(x)),
                  levels = c("Affordable", "Medium", "Expensive")))
  }

  brks <- unique(as.numeric(quantile(x, probs = c(0, 1/3, 2/3, 1), na.rm = TRUE)))
  if (length(brks) < 4) {
    rk <- rank(x, ties.method = "average")
    grp <- ntile(rk, 3)
    out <- c("Affordable", "Medium", "Expensive")[grp]
    return(factor(out, levels = c("Affordable", "Medium", "Expensive")))
  }

  cut(
    x,
    breaks = brks,
    include.lowest = TRUE,
    labels = c("Affordable", "Medium", "Expensive")
  )
}

cluster_neighborhoods <- function(df, k = 3, price_basis = "median_price") {
  feature_vars <- c(
    "mean_price", "median_price", "min_price", "max_price", "q1_price", "q3_price", "sd_price",
    "mean_accommodates", "mean_bedrooms", "mean_beds", "mean_bathrooms",
    "wifi_rate", "kitchen_rate", "parking_rate", "ac_rate", "pool_rate",
    "gym_rate", "tv_rate", "washer_rate", "dryer_rate", "elevator_rate",
    "workspace_rate", "pets_rate"
  )

  feature_vars <- feature_vars[feature_vars %in% names(df)]
  x <- df[, feature_vars, drop = FALSE]

  x_scaled <- scale(x)
  x_scaled[is.na(x_scaled)] <- 0

  set.seed(123)
  km <- kmeans(x_scaled, centers = k, nstart = 50)

  out <- df %>%
    mutate(
      cluster_id = km$cluster,
      cluster = paste0("Cluster ", km$cluster),
      price_tier = assign_price_tier(.data[[price_basis]])
    )

  out
}

compute_pca_payload <- function(df) {
  vars <- c(
    "mean_price", "median_price", "min_price", "max_price", "q1_price", "q3_price", "sd_price",
    "mean_accommodates", "mean_bedrooms", "mean_beds", "mean_bathrooms",
    "wifi_rate", "kitchen_rate", "parking_rate", "ac_rate", "pool_rate",
    "gym_rate", "tv_rate", "washer_rate", "dryer_rate", "elevator_rate",
    "workspace_rate", "pets_rate"
  )
  vars <- vars[vars %in% names(df)]

  x <- df[, vars, drop = FALSE]
  x <- x[, apply(x, 2, function(col) sd(col, na.rm = TRUE) > 0), drop = FALSE]

  if (ncol(x) < 2) {
    return(list(
      scores = data.frame(),
      loadings = data.frame(),
      variance = c(PC1 = NA_real_, PC2 = NA_real_, PC3 = NA_real_)
    ))
  }

  pca <- prcomp(x, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

  scores <- as.data.frame(pca$x[, seq_len(min(3, ncol(pca$x))), drop = FALSE])
  if (!("PC1" %in% names(scores))) scores$PC1 <- 0
  if (!("PC2" %in% names(scores))) scores$PC2 <- 0
  if (!("PC3" %in% names(scores))) scores$PC3 <- 0

  scores <- scores %>%
    mutate(
      city = df$city,
      neighbourhood_key = df$neighbourhood_key,
      cluster = df$cluster,
      price_tier = df$price_tier,
      median_price = df$median_price,
      n_listings = df$n_listings
    )

  loadings <- as.data.frame(pca$rotation[, seq_len(min(3, ncol(pca$rotation))), drop = FALSE])
  if (!("PC1" %in% names(loadings))) loadings$PC1 <- 0
  if (!("PC2" %in% names(loadings))) loadings$PC2 <- 0
  if (!("PC3" %in% names(loadings))) loadings$PC3 <- 0
  loadings$variable <- rownames(loadings)

  imp <- summary(pca)$importance
  variance <- c(
    PC1 = ifelse(ncol(imp) >= 1, imp[2, 1], NA_real_),
    PC2 = ifelse(ncol(imp) >= 2, imp[2, 2], NA_real_),
    PC3 = ifelse(ncol(imp) >= 3, imp[2, 3], NA_real_)
  )

  list(scores = scores, loadings = loadings, variance = variance)
}

make_popup_html <- function(df) {
  paste0(
    "<div style='font-family:Inter,Arial,sans-serif;'>",
    "<div style='font-weight:800;font-size:14px;margin-bottom:6px;'>", htmlEscape(df$neighbourhood_key), "</div>",
    "<div><b>City:</b> ", htmlEscape(df$city), "</div>",
    "<div><b>Listings:</b> ", comma(df$n_listings), "</div>",
    "<div><b>Mean price:</b> $", comma(round(df$mean_price, 0)), "</div>",
    "<div><b>Median price:</b> $", comma(round(df$median_price, 0)), "</div>",
    "<div><b>Min:</b> $", comma(round(df$min_price, 0)), "</div>",
    "<div><b>Max:</b> $", comma(round(df$max_price, 0)), "</div>",
    "<div><b>Cluster:</b> ", htmlEscape(df$cluster), "</div>",
    "<div><b>Price tier:</b> ", htmlEscape(as.character(df$price_tier)), "</div>",
    "</div>"
  )
}

tier_palette <- c(
  "Affordable" = "#10B981",
  "Medium" = "#F59E0B",
  "Expensive" = "#EF4444"
)

cluster_palette <- function(n) {
  cols <- brewer.pal(max(3, min(8, n)), "Set2")
  cols[seq_len(n)]
}

if (!file.exists(BOSTON_FILE)) stop(paste("Missing file:", BOSTON_FILE))
if (!file.exists(JERSEY_FILE)) stop(paste("Missing file:", JERSEY_FILE))

boston_raw <- read_csv(BOSTON_FILE, show_col_types = FALSE)
jersey_raw <- read_csv(JERSEY_FILE, show_col_types = FALSE)

boston <- normalize_city_data(boston_raw, "Boston")
jersey <- normalize_city_data(jersey_raw, "Jersey City")

listings_all <- bind_rows(boston, jersey) %>%
  prepare_listing_features()

neighborhoods_base <- aggregate_neighborhoods(listings_all)

app_theme <- bs_theme(

ui <- page_navbar(

      value_box(

    card(

      card_body(

      )
    )
  ),

  nav_panel(
    "PCA",
    layout_columns(
      col_widths = c(7, 5),
      card(
        full_screen = TRUE,
```
