```{r}
        plotlyOutput("pca_scores", height = "620px")
      ),
      card(
        full_screen = TRUE,
        style = "border-radius:20px;",
        card_header("PCA loadings"),
        plotlyOutput("pca_loadings", height = "620px")
      )
    )
  ),

  nav_panel(
    "Tables",
    layout_columns(
      col_widths = c(12),
      card(
        style = "border-radius:20px;",
        card_header("Neighborhood summary"),
        DTOutput("summary_table")
      ),
      card(
        style = "border-radius:20px;",
        card_header("Listings in selected neighborhoods"),
        DTOutput("listing_table")
      )
    )
  ),

  nav_panel(
    "Diagnostics",
    layout_columns(
      col_widths = c(6, 6),
      card(
        full_screen = TRUE,
        style = "border-radius:20px;",
        card_header("Neighborhood price distribution"),
        plotlyOutput("price_hist", height = "420px")
      ),
      card(
        full_screen = TRUE,
        style = "border-radius:20px;",
        card_header("Cluster vs median price"),
        plotlyOutput("cluster_box", height = "420px")
      )
    ),
    layout_columns(
      col_widths = c(6, 6),
      card(
        full_screen = TRUE,
        style = "border-radius:20px;",
        card_header("Mean vs median price"),
        plotlyOutput("scatter_price", height = "420px")
      ),
      card(
        full_screen = TRUE,
        style = "border-radius:20px;",
        card_header("Amenities summary"),
        plotlyOutput("amenity_bars", height = "420px")
      )
    )
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {

  clustered_data <- reactive({
    df <- neighborhoods_base

    if (!identical(input$city_filter, "All")) {
      df <- df %>% filter(city == input$city_filter)
    }

    df <- df %>%
      filter(
        n_listings >= input$min_listings,
        median_price >= input$median_range[1],
        median_price <= input$median_range[2]
      )

    if (!is.null(input$neighborhood_select) && length(input$neighborhood_select) > 0) {
      df <- df %>% filter(neighbourhood_key %in% input$neighborhood_select)
    }

    validate(need(nrow(df) >= input$n_clusters, "Not enough neighborhoods for the selected number of clusters."))

    cluster_neighborhoods(
      df = df,
      k = input$n_clusters,
      price_basis = input$price_basis
    )
  })

  pca_payload <- reactive({
    compute_pca_payload(clustered_data())
  })

  listings_filtered <- reactive({
    nhoods <- clustered_data() %>% pull(neighbourhood_key)
    cities <- clustered_data() %>% distinct(city) %>% pull(city)

    listings_all %>%
      filter(city %in% cities, neighbourhood_key %in% nhoods)
  })

  output$vb_nhoods <- renderText({
    comma(nrow(clustered_data()))
  })

  output$vb_median <- renderText({
    paste0("$", comma(round(median(clustered_data()$median_price, na.rm = TRUE), 0)))
  })

  output$vb_clusters <- renderText({
    length(unique(clustered_data()$cluster))
  })

  output$price_map <- renderMaplibre({
    df <- clustered_data()

    validate(need(nrow(df) > 0, "No neighborhoods to map."))

    map_df <- st_as_sf(
      df,
      coords = c("longitude", "latitude"),
      crs = 4326,
      remove = FALSE
    )

    map_df$popup_html <- make_popup_html(map_df)

    if (identical(input$color_by, "price_tier")) {
      circle_colors <- mapgl::match_expr(
        "price_tier",
        values = names(tier_palette),
        stops = unname(tier_palette)
      )
      legend_values <- names(tier_palette)
      legend_colors <- unname(tier_palette)
      legend_title  <- "Price tier"
    } else {
      clust_vals <- sort(unique(map_df$cluster))
      clust_cols <- cluster_palette(length(clust_vals))
      circle_colors <- mapgl::match_expr(
        "cluster",
        values = clust_vals,
        stops = clust_cols
      )
      legend_values <- clust_vals
      legend_colors <- clust_cols
      legend_title  <- "Cluster"
    }

    rad <- mapgl::interpolate(
      column = "median_price",
      values = c(min(map_df$median_price, na.rm = TRUE), max(map_df$median_price, na.rm = TRUE)),
      stops = c(8, 24)
    )

    mapgl::maplibre(
      style = mapgl::carto_style("positron"),
      center = c(mean(df$longitude, na.rm = TRUE), mean(df$latitude, na.rm = TRUE)),
      zoom = ifelse(length(unique(df$city)) == 1, 11, 8)
    ) %>%
      mapgl::add_navigation_control() %>%
      mapgl::add_fullscreen_control() %>%
      mapgl::add_circle_layer(
        id = "neighborhood_points",
        source = map_df,
        circle_color = circle_colors,
        circle_radius = rad,
        circle_opacity = 0.85,
        circle_stroke_color = "#FFFFFF",
        circle_stroke_width = 1.5,
        popup = "popup_html",
        tooltip = "neighbourhood_key",
        hover_options = list(
          circle_radius = 28,
          circle_opacity = 1
        )
      ) %>%
      mapgl::add_categorical_legend(
        legend_title = legend_title,
        values = legend_values,
        colors = legend_colors,
        circular_patches = TRUE
      )
  })

  output$pca_scores <- renderPlotly({
    scores <- pca_payload()$scores

    validate(need(nrow(scores) > 0, "PCA unavailable for the current filter."))

    plot_ly(
      data = scores,
      x = ~PC1,
      y = ~PC2,
      type = "scatter",
      mode = "markers",
      color = ~price_tier,
      colors = tier_palette,
      symbol = ~cluster,
      symbols = c("circle", "square", "diamond", "x", "triangle-up", "cross", "star", "triangle-down"),
      size = ~median_price,
      sizes = c(10, 30),
      text = ~paste0(
        "<b>", neighbourhood_key, "</b>",
        "<br>City: ", city,
        "<br>Median price: $", comma(round(median_price, 0)),
        "<br>Listings: ", comma(n_listings),
        "<br>Cluster: ", cluster,
        "<br>Tier: ", price_tier
      ),
      hovertemplate = "%{text}<br>PC1=%{x:.2f}<br>PC2=%{y:.2f}<extra></extra>"
    ) %>%
      layout(
        title = paste0(
          "PCA scores",
          "<br><sup>Explained variance: PC1 = ",
          percent(pca_payload()$variance["PC1"], accuracy = 0.1),
          ", PC2 = ",
          percent(pca_payload()$variance["PC2"], accuracy = 0.1),
          "</sup>"
        ),
        xaxis = list(title = "PC1"),
        yaxis = list(title = "PC2"),
        legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0, y = -0.15)
      )
  })

  output$pca_loadings <- renderPlotly({
    loadings <- pca_payload()$loadings

    validate(need(nrow(loadings) > 0, "PCA loadings unavailable for the current filter."))

    plot_ly(
      data = loadings,
      x = ~PC1,
      y = ~PC2,
      type = "scatter",
      mode = "markers+text",
      text = ~variable,
      textposition = "top center",
      hovertemplate = paste0(
        "<b>%{text}</b>",
        "<br>PC1 = %{x:.3f}",
        "<br>PC2 = %{y:.3f}<extra></extra>"
      )
    ) %>%
      add_segments(
        x = 0, y = 0,
        xend = ~PC1, yend = ~PC2,
        inherit = FALSE,
        showlegend = FALSE
      ) %>%
      layout(
        title = "PCA loadings",
        xaxis = list(title = "PC1", zeroline = TRUE),
        yaxis = list(title = "PC2", zeroline = TRUE)
      )
  })

  output$summary_table <- renderDT({
    df <- clustered_data() %>%
      mutate(
        price_tier = as.character(price_tier)
      ) %>%
      select(
        city, neighbourhood_key, n_listings, cluster, price_tier,
        mean_price, median_price, min_price, max_price, q1_price, q3_price, sd_price,
        mean_accommodates, mean_bedrooms, mean_beds, mean_bathrooms,
        wifi_rate, kitchen_rate, parking_rate, ac_rate, pool_rate,
        gym_rate, tv_rate, washer_rate, dryer_rate, elevator_rate,
        workspace_rate, pets_rate
      ) %>%
      arrange(desc(median_price))

    datatable(
      df,
      rownames = FALSE,
      extensions = "Buttons",
      options = list(
        pageLength = 12,
        scrollX = TRUE,
        dom = "Bfrtip",
        buttons = c("copy", "csv", "excel")
      )
    ) %>%
      formatCurrency(c("mean_price", "median_price", "min_price", "max_price", "q1_price", "q3_price"), currency = "$", digits = 0) %>%
      formatRound(c("sd_price", "mean_accommodates", "mean_bedrooms", "mean_beds", "mean_bathrooms"), 2) %>%
      formatPercentage(
        c("wifi_rate", "kitchen_rate", "parking_rate", "ac_rate", "pool_rate",
          "gym_rate", "tv_rate", "washer_rate", "dryer_rate", "elevator_rate",
          "workspace_rate", "pets_rate"), 1
      )
  })

  output$listing_table <- renderDT({
    df <- listings_filtered() %>%
      select(
        city, neighbourhood_key, listing_label, price,
        accommodates, bedrooms, beds, bathrooms_num,
        latitude, longitude
      ) %>%
      arrange(desc(price))

    datatable(
      df,
      rownames = FALSE,
      extensions = "Buttons",
      options = list(
        pageLength = 12,
        scrollX = TRUE,
        dom = "Bfrtip",
        buttons = c("copy", "csv", "excel")
      )
    ) %>%
      formatCurrency("price", currency = "$", digits = 0) %>%
      formatRound(c("bathrooms_num", "latitude", "longitude"), 2)
  })

  output$price_hist <- renderPlotly({
    df <- clustered_data()

    plot_ly(
      data = df,
      x = ~median_price,
      color = ~price_tier,
      colors = tier_palette,
      type = "histogram"
    ) %>%
      layout(
        title = "Distribution of neighborhood median prices",
        xaxis = list(title = "Neighborhood median price"),
        yaxis = list(title = "Count")
      )
  })

  output$cluster_box <- renderPlotly({
    df <- clustered_data()

    plot_ly(
      data = df,
      x = ~cluster,
      y = ~median_price,
      color = ~cluster,
      type = "box",
      boxpoints = "all",
      jitter = 0.2,
      pointpos = 0
    ) %>%
      layout(
        title = "Median price by cluster",
        xaxis = list(title = "Cluster"),
        yaxis = list(title = "Neighborhood median price")
      )
  })

  output$scatter_price <- renderPlotly({
    df <- clustered_data()

    plot_ly(
      data = df,
      x = ~mean_price,
      y = ~median_price,
      color = ~price_tier,
      colors = tier_palette,
      type = "scatter",
      mode = "markers",
      text = ~paste0(
        "<b>", neighbourhood_key, "</b>",
        "<br>City: ", city,
        "<br>Cluster: ", cluster,
        "<br>Mean: $", comma(round(mean_price, 0)),
        "<br>Median: $", comma(round(median_price, 0))
      ),
      hovertemplate = "%{text}<extra></extra>"
    ) %>%
      layout(
        title = "Mean vs median neighborhood price",
        xaxis = list(title = "Mean price"),
        yaxis = list(title = "Median price")
      )
  })

  output$amenity_bars <- renderPlotly({
    df <- clustered_data()

    amenity_df <- df %>%
      summarise(
        WiFi = mean(wifi_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
        Kitchen = mean(kitchen_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
        Parking = mean(parking_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
        AC = mean(ac_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
        Pool = mean(pool_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
        Gym = mean(gym_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
        TV = mean(tv_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
        Washer = mean(washer_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
        Dryer = mean(dryer_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
        Elevator = mean(elevator_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
        Workspace = mean(workspace_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
        Pets = mean(pets_rate, na.rm = TRUE)
      ) %>%
      pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "amenity", values_to = "rate")

    plot_ly(
      data = amenity_df,
      x = ~reorder(amenity, rate),
      y = ~rate,
      type = "bar"
    ) %>%
      layout(
        title = "Average amenity presence across shown neighborhoods",
        xaxis = list(title = ""),
        yaxis = list(title = "Rate", tickformat = ".0%")
      )
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(scales)

boston <- read.csv("listings_Boston.csv")
jersey <- read.csv("listings_Jersey.csv")

clean_price <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("[\\$, ]", "", x)
  as.numeric(x)
}

boston$price <- clean_price(boston$price)
jersey$price <- clean_price(jersey$price)

boston <- boston %>% filter(!is.na(price))
jersey <- jersey %>% filter(!is.na(price))

get_region <- function(df) {
  if ("neighbourhood_cleansed" %in% names(df)) return("neighbourhood_cleansed")
  if ("neighbourhood" %in% names(df)) return("neighbourhood")
  if ("zipcode" %in% names(df)) return("zipcode")
}

boston$region <- boston[[get_region(boston)]]
jersey$region <- jersey[[get_region(jersey)]]

boston$city <- "Boston"
jersey$city <- "Jersey City"

data <- bind_rows(boston, jersey)


neighborhoods <- data %>%
  group_by(city, region) %>%
  summarise(
    n_listings = n(),
    mean_price = mean(price),
    median_price = median(price),
    min_price = min(price),
    max_price = max(price),
    sd_price = sd(price),
    q1 = quantile(price, 0.25),
    q3 = quantile(price, 0.75),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

features <- neighborhoods %>%
  select(mean_price, median_price, min_price, max_price, sd_price, q1, q3)

scaled_features <- scale(features)

set.seed(123)
k <- 3

kmeans_model <- kmeans(scaled_features, centers = k, nstart = 25)

neighborhoods$cluster <- factor(kmeans_model$cluster)

neighborhoods$price_tier <- cut(
  neighborhoods$median_price,
  breaks = quantile(neighborhoods$median_price, probs = c(0, 1/3, 2/3, 1)),
  include.lowest = TRUE,
  labels = c("Affordable", "Medium", "Expensive")
)

# PCA
pca <- prcomp(scaled_features, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

pca_scores <- as.data.frame(pca$x[,1:2])
pca_scores$cluster <- neighborhoods$cluster
pca_scores$price_tier <- neighborhoods$price_tier
pca_scores$region <- neighborhoods$region
pca_scores$city <- neighborhoods$city

summary(pca)

ggplot(pca_scores, aes(PC1, PC2, color = price_tier, shape = cluster)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "PCA of Neighborhood Prices",
    subtitle = "Colored by Price Tier, shaped by Cluster"
  )


ggplot(neighborhoods, aes(cluster, median_price, fill = cluster)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Cluster vs Median Price")

ggplot(neighborhoods, aes(mean_price, median_price, color = cluster)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Mean vs Median Price")


loadings <- as.data.frame(pca$rotation[,1:2])
loadings$variable <- rownames(loadings)

ggplot(loadings, aes(0, 0)) +
  geom_segment(aes(xend = PC1, yend = PC2), arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2,"cm"))) +
  geom_text(aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, label = variable), size = 4) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "PCA Loadings (What drives variation)")


head(neighborhoods)
```

```{r}

cran_packages <- c(
  "rlang",
  "tidyverse",
  "ggrepel",
  "ggtext",
  "patchwork",
  "factoextra",
  "viridis",
  "scales",
  "glue",
  "circlize",
  "cluster",
  "gridExtra",
  "GGally",
  "fmsb"
)

installed_pkgs <- rownames(installed.packages())

for (pkg in cran_packages) {
  if (!(pkg %in% installed_pkgs)) {
    install.packages(pkg, dependencies = TRUE)
  }
}

if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("BiocManager")
}

if (!("ComplexHeatmap" %in% rownames(installed.packages()))) {
  BiocManager::install("ComplexHeatmap", ask = FALSE, update = FALSE)
}

# 1. LOAD LIBRARIES
library(rlang)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggtext)
library(patchwork)
library(factoextra)
library(viridis)
library(scales)
library(glue)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(grid)
library(cluster)
library(gridExtra)
library(GGally)
library(fmsb)

pacmap_available <- requireNamespace("reticulate", quietly = TRUE) &&
  reticulate::py_module_available("pacmap")

clean_price <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("[\\$, ]", "", x)
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

get_region <- function(df) {
  if ("neighbourhood_cleansed" %in% names(df)) return("neighbourhood_cleansed")
  if ("neighbourhood" %in% names(df)) return("neighbourhood")
  if ("zipcode" %in% names(df)) return("zipcode")
  stop("No neighborhood column found.")
}

wrap_text_vec <- function(x, width = 18) {
  stringr::str_wrap(as.character(x), width = width)
}

theme_pro <- function() {
  ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title = ggtext::element_markdown(face = "bold", size = 18, color = "#111827"),
      plot.subtitle = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 12, color = "#4B5563"),
      axis.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", color = "#111827"),
      axis.text = ggplot2::element_text(color = "#374151"),
      strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", size = 11, color = "#111827"),
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"),
      panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = ggplot2::element_line(color = "#E5E7EB", linewidth = 0.4),
      plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(12, 12, 12, 12)
    )
}

save_plot_hi <- function(plot_obj, filename, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 500) {
  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = filename,
    plot = plot_obj,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = dpi,
    bg = "white"
  )
}

cluster_cols <- c(
  "Cluster 1" = "#2563EB",
  "Cluster 2" = "#7C3AED",
  "Cluster 3" = "#10B981",
  "Cluster 4" = "#F59E0B",
  "Cluster 5" = "#EF4444",
  "Cluster 6" = "#06B6D4"
)

tier_cols <- c(
  "Affordable" = "#22C55E",
  "Medium" = "#F59E0B",
  "Expensive" = "#EF4444"
)


boston <- read.csv("listings_Boston.csv")
jersey <- read.csv("listings_Jersey.csv")

boston$price <- clean_price(boston$price)
jersey$price <- clean_price(jersey$price)

boston <- boston %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(price), price > 0, price <= 1000)

jersey <- jersey %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(price), price > 0, price <= 1000)

boston$region <- boston[[get_region(boston)]]
jersey$region <- jersey[[get_region(jersey)]]

boston$city <- "Boston"
jersey$city <- "Jersey City"

data_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(boston, jersey) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(region), trimws(region) != "")

neighborhoods <- data_all %>%
  dplyr::group_by(city, region) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_listings   = dplyr::n(),
    mean_price   = mean(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_price = median(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_price    = min(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_price    = max(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_price     = sd(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    q1_price     = quantile(price, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q3_price     = quantile(price, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    iqr_price    = IQR(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(n_listings >= 5) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    sd_price = tidyr::replace_na(sd_price, 0),
    region_wrapped = wrap_text_vec(region, width = 16)
  )

feature_names <- c(
  "mean_price", "median_price", "min_price", "max_price",
  "sd_price", "q1_price", "q3_price", "iqr_price"
)

feature_df <- neighborhoods %>%
  dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(feature_names))

scaled_features <- scale(feature_df)
rownames(scaled_features) <- neighborhoods$region

set.seed(123)

p_elbow <- factoextra::fviz_nbclust(scaled_features, kmeans, method = "wss") +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "<b>Elbow method</b>",
    subtitle = "Choose k where improvement starts flattening",
    x = "Number of clusters (k)",
    y = "Within-cluster sum of squares"
  ) +
  theme_pro()

p_sil_k <- factoextra::fviz_nbclust(scaled_features, kmeans, method = "silhouette") +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "<b>Silhouette method</b>",
    subtitle = "Higher average silhouette width is better",
    x = "Number of clusters (k)",
    y = "Average silhouette width"
  ) +
  theme_pro()

gap_stat <- cluster::clusGap(scaled_features, FUN = kmeans, nstart = 25, K.max = 8, B = 100)

p_gap <- factoextra::fviz_gap_stat(gap_stat) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "<b>Gap statistic</b>",
    subtitle = "Higher values suggest stronger clustering structure"
  ) +
  theme_pro()

# Final k
k <- 3


set.seed(123)
km <- kmeans(scaled_features, centers = k, nstart = 50)

dist_mat <- stats::dist(scaled_features)
hc <- stats::hclust(dist_mat, method = "ward.D2")
hc_clusters <- stats::cutree(hc, k = k)

pam_fit <- cluster::pam(scaled_features, k = k)

neighborhoods <- neighborhoods %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    cluster = factor(km$cluster, labels = paste("Cluster", 1:k)),
    cluster_hc = factor(hc_clusters, labels = paste("Cluster", 1:k)),
    cluster_pam = factor(pam_fit$clustering, labels = paste("Cluster", 1:k))
  )

cluster_cols_use <- cluster_cols[levels(neighborhoods$cluster)]


tier_breaks <- stats::quantile(
  neighborhoods$median_price,
  probs = c(0, 1/3, 2/3, 1),
  na.rm = TRUE
)

if (length(unique(tier_breaks)) < 4) {
  neighborhoods <- neighborhoods %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      price_tier = dplyr::ntile(median_price, 3),
      price_tier = factor(
        price_tier,
        levels = 1:3,
        labels = c("Affordable", "Medium", "Expensive")
      )
    )
} else {
  neighborhoods <- neighborhoods %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      price_tier = cut(
        median_price,
        breaks = tier_breaks,
        include.lowest = TRUE,
        labels = c("Affordable", "Medium", "Expensive")
      )
    )
}

pca <- stats::prcomp(scaled_features, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

scores_mat <- as.data.frame(pca$x[, 1:2])
scores <- dplyr::bind_cols(
  neighborhoods %>%
    dplyr::select(
      city, region, region_wrapped, cluster, cluster_hc, cluster_pam,
      price_tier, median_price, n_listings
    ),
  scores_mat
)

loadings <- as.data.frame(pca$rotation[, 1:2])
loadings$feature <- rownames(loadings)

var_expl <- summary(pca)$importance[2, 1:2]


cluster_summary <- neighborhoods %>%
  dplyr::group_by(cluster) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    neighborhoods = dplyr::n(),
    avg_mean_price = mean(mean_price),
    avg_median_price = mean(median_price),
    avg_min_price = mean(min_price),
    avg_max_price = mean(max_price),
    avg_sd_price = mean(sd_price),
    avg_q1_price = mean(q1_price),
    avg_q3_price = mean(q3_price),
    avg_iqr_price = mean(iqr_price),
    avg_listings = mean(n_listings),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 2)))

cluster_centers_scaled <- as.data.frame(km$centers) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(cluster = paste("Cluster", seq_len(n()))) %>%
  dplyr::relocate(cluster) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(-cluster, ~ round(., 3)))

cluster_centers_original <- neighborhoods %>%
  dplyr::group_by(cluster) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(feature_names), ~ round(mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE), 2)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cluster_membership <- neighborhoods %>%
  dplyr::arrange(cluster, dplyr::desc(median_price)) %>%
  dplyr::select(city, region, cluster, price_tier, median_price, mean_price, n_listings)


eig_df <- data.frame(
  PC = factor(paste0("PC", seq_along(pca$sdev)), levels = paste0("PC", seq_along(pca$sdev))),
  variance = (pca$sdev^2) / sum(pca$sdev^2)
)

p_scree <- eig_df %>%
  dplyr::slice(1:6) %>%
  ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(PC, variance)) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(fill = "#2563EB", width = 0.75) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(
    ggplot2::aes(label = scales::percent(variance, accuracy = 0.1)),
    vjust = -0.5,
    size = 3.8
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::percent_format(),
    expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "<b>Scree plot</b>",
    subtitle = "Variance explained by each principal component",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Explained variance"
  ) +
  theme_pro()


p_pca <- ggplot2::ggplot(scores, ggplot2::aes(PC1, PC2, color = cluster, size = median_price)) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(alpha = 0.92) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    ggplot2::aes(label = region_wrapped),
    size = 3.1,
    max.overlaps = 35,
    box.padding = 0.45,
    min.segment.length = 0
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = cluster_cols_use) +
  ggplot2::scale_size_continuous(range = c(3, 9), labels = scales::dollar_format()) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "<b>PCA scatter plot</b>",
    subtitle = glue::glue(
      "PC1 explains <b>{scales::percent(var_expl[1], 0.1)}</b>; ",
      "PC2 explains <b>{scales::percent(var_expl[2], 0.1)}</b>"
    ),
    x = "Principal Component 1",
    y = "Principal Component 2",
    color = "Cluster",
    size = "Median price"
  ) +
  theme_pro()

p_scatter_mean_median <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  neighborhoods,
  ggplot2::aes(mean_price, median_price, color = cluster, size = n_listings)
) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(alpha = 0.92) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
```

```{r}
cran_packages <- c(
  "tidyverse",
  "cluster",
  "factoextra",
  "ggrepel",
  "patchwork",
  "viridis",
  "scales",
  "GGally"
)

installed_pkgs <- rownames(installed.packages())

for (pkg in cran_packages) {
  if (!(pkg %in% installed_pkgs)) {
    install.packages(pkg, dependencies = TRUE)
  }
}

# LIBRARIES
library(tidyverse)
library(cluster)
library(factoextra)
library(ggrepel)
library(patchwork)
library(viridis)
library(scales)
library(GGally)


clean_price <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("[\\$, ]", "", x)
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

get_region <- function(df) {
  if ("neighbourhood_cleansed" %in% names(df)) return("neighbourhood_cleansed")
  if ("neighbourhood" %in% names(df)) return("neighbourhood")
  if ("zipcode" %in% names(df)) return("zipcode")
  stop("No neighborhood column found.")
}

wrap_text_vec <- function(x, width = 18) {
  stringr::str_wrap(as.character(x), width = width)
}

safe_num <- function(x) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))

detect_amenity <- function(x, pattern) {
  stringr::str_detect(stringr::str_to_lower(dplyr::coalesce(x, "")), pattern)
}

theme_pro <- function() {
  ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", size = 18, color = "#111827"),
      plot.subtitle = ggplot2::element_text(size = 12, color = "#4B5563"),
      axis.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", color = "#111827"),
      axis.text = ggplot2::element_text(color = "#374151"),
      strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", size = 11, color = "#111827"),
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"),
      panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = ggplot2::element_line(color = "#E5E7EB", linewidth = 0.4),
      plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(12, 12, 12, 12)
    )
}

save_plot_hi <- function(plot_obj, filename, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 500) {
  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = filename,
    plot = plot_obj,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = dpi,
    bg = "white"
  )
}

cluster_cols <- c(
  "Cluster 1" = "#2563EB",
  "Cluster 2" = "#7C3AED",
  "Cluster 3" = "#10B981",
  "Cluster 4" = "#F59E0B",
  "Cluster 5" = "#EF4444"
)

boston <- read.csv("listings_Boston.csv")
jersey <- read.csv("listings_Jersey.csv")

boston$price <- clean_price(boston$price)
jersey$price <- clean_price(jersey$price)

boston <- boston %>%
  filter(!is.na(price), price > 0, price <= 1000)

jersey <- jersey %>%
  filter(!is.na(price), price > 0, price <= 1000)

boston$region <- boston[[get_region(boston)]]
jersey$region <- jersey[[get_region(jersey)]]

boston$city <- "Boston"
jersey$city <- "Jersey City"


for (nm in c("accommodates", "bedrooms", "beds", "latitude", "longitude")) {
  if (nm %in% names(boston)) boston[[nm]] <- safe_num(boston[[nm]])
  if (nm %in% names(jersey)) jersey[[nm]] <- safe_num(jersey[[nm]])
}

if ("bathrooms" %in% names(boston)) {
  boston$bathrooms_num <- if (is.character(boston$bathrooms)) readr::parse_number(boston$bathrooms) else safe_num(boston$bathrooms)
} else {
  boston$bathrooms_num <- NA_real_
}

if ("bathrooms" %in% names(jersey)) {
  jersey$bathrooms_num <- if (is.character(jersey$bathrooms)) readr::parse_number(jersey$bathrooms) else safe_num(jersey$bathrooms)
} else {
  jersey$bathrooms_num <- NA_real_
}

if (!("amenities" %in% names(boston))) boston$amenities <- ""
if (!("amenities" %in% names(jersey))) jersey$amenities <- ""

data_all <- bind_rows(boston, jersey) %>%
  filter(!is.na(region), trimws(region) != "")


data_all <- data_all %>%
  mutate(
    has_tv = detect_amenity(amenities, "tv|television|hdtv|roku|chromecast"),
    has_dishes = detect_amenity(amenities, "dishes and silverware|dishes|silverware"),
    has_gym = detect_amenity(amenities, "gym|workout equipment|exercise equipment"),
    has_parking = detect_amenity(amenities, "parking|garage|carport|driveway|street parking"),
    has_cooking = detect_amenity(amenities, "cooking basics"),
    has_pets = detect_amenity(amenities, "pets allowed"),
    has_heating = detect_amenity(amenities, "heating"),
    has_balcony = detect_amenity(amenities, "patio|balcony"),
    has_hotwater = detect_amenity(amenities, "hot water"),
    has_ac = detect_amenity(amenities, "air conditioning|ceiling fan|portable fans|window ac|central air"),

    # added 5
    has_wifi = detect_amenity(amenities, "wifi|internet|ethernet"),
    has_washer = detect_amenity(amenities, "washer"),
    has_dryer = detect_amenity(amenities, "dryer"),
    has_workspace = detect_amenity(amenities, "dedicated workspace|workspace|desk"),
    has_elevator = detect_amenity(amenities, "elevator")
  )

neighborhoods <- data_all %>%
  group_by(city, region) %>%
  summarise(
    n_listings = n(),
    mean_price = mean(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_price = median(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_price = sd(price, na.rm = TRUE),
    iqr_price = IQR(price, na.rm = TRUE),

    mean_accommodates = mean(accommodates, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_bedrooms = mean(bedrooms, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_beds = mean(beds, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_bathrooms = mean(bathrooms_num, na.rm = TRUE),

    tv_rate = mean(has_tv, na.rm = TRUE),
    dishes_rate = mean(has_dishes, na.rm = TRUE),
    gym_rate = mean(has_gym, na.rm = TRUE),
    parking_rate = mean(has_parking, na.rm = TRUE),
    cooking_rate = mean(has_cooking, na.rm = TRUE),
    pets_rate = mean(has_pets, na.rm = TRUE),
    heating_rate = mean(has_heating, na.rm = TRUE),
    balcony_rate = mean(has_balcony, na.rm = TRUE),
    hotwater_rate = mean(has_hotwater, na.rm = TRUE),
    ac_rate = mean(has_ac, na.rm = TRUE),

    wifi_rate = mean(has_wifi, na.rm = TRUE),
    washer_rate = mean(has_washer, na.rm = TRUE),
    dryer_rate = mean(has_dryer, na.rm = TRUE),
    workspace_rate = mean(has_workspace, na.rm = TRUE),
    elevator_rate = mean(has_elevator, na.rm = TRUE),

    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n_listings >= 5) %>%
  mutate(
    sd_price = tidyr::replace_na(sd_price, 0),
    region_wrapped = wrap_text_vec(region, width = 16)
  )

upper_cut <- quantile(neighborhoods$median_price, 0.98, na.rm = TRUE)
neighborhoods <- neighborhoods %>%
  filter(median_price <= upper_cut)


feature_df <- neighborhoods %>%
  transmute(
    log_price = log1p(median_price),
    log_sd = log1p(sd_price),
    log_iqr = log1p(iqr_price),
    log_n_listings = log1p(n_listings),
    log_accommodates = log1p(mean_accommodates),
    log_bedrooms = log1p(mean_bedrooms),
    log_beds = log1p(mean_beds),
    log_bathrooms = log1p(mean_bathrooms),

    tv_rate,
    dishes_rate,
    gym_rate,
    parking_rate,
    cooking_rate,
    pets_rate,
    heating_rate,
    balcony_rate,
    hotwater_rate,
    ac_rate,
    wifi_rate,
    washer_rate,
    dryer_rate,
    workspace_rate,
    elevator_rate
  )

scaled_features <- scale(feature_df)
rownames(scaled_features) <- paste(neighborhoods$city, neighborhoods$region, sep = " | ")



pca <- prcomp(scaled_features, center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE)

cum_var <- cumsum((pca$sdev^2) / sum(pca$sdev^2))
n_pc <- which(cum_var >= 0.90)[1]
if (is.na(n_pc)) n_pc <- min(3, ncol(pca$x))

pc_scores <- pca$x[, 1:n_pc, drop = FALSE]

plot_scores <- as.data.frame(pca$x[, 1:2, drop = FALSE])
names(plot_scores) <- c("PC1", "PC2")

var_expl <- summary(pca)$importance[2, 1:2]



candidate_k <- 2:5
min_cluster_size <- 3

sil_results <- data.frame(
  k = integer(),
  avg_sil = numeric(),
  min_cluster = integer()
)

pam_models <- list()

for (k in candidate_k) {
  pam_fit <- pam(pc_scores, k = k)
  sil <- silhouette(pam_fit$clustering, dist(pc_scores))
  cl_sizes <- table(pam_fit$clustering)

  sil_results <- bind_rows(
    sil_results,
    data.frame(
      k = k,
      avg_sil = mean(sil[, "sil_width"]),
      min_cluster = min(cl_sizes)
    )
  )

  pam_models[[as.character(k)]] <- pam_fit
}

print(sil_results)

eligible_k <- sil_results %>%
  filter(min_cluster >= min_cluster_size)

if (nrow(eligible_k) == 0) {
  best_k <- sil_results$k[which.max(sil_results$avg_sil)]
} else {
  best_k <- eligible_k$k[which.max(eligible_k$avg_sil)]
}

cat("Chosen k =", best_k, "\n")

best_pam <- pam_models[[as.character(best_k)]]


neighborhoods$cluster_num <- best_pam$clustering

cluster_order <- neighborhoods %>%
  group_by(cluster_num) %>%
  summarise(cluster_median = median(median_price), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(cluster_median) %>%
  mutate(cluster_label = paste("Cluster", row_number()))

label_map <- setNames(cluster_order$cluster_label, cluster_order$cluster_num)

neighborhoods$cluster <- factor(
  label_map[as.character(neighborhoods$cluster_num)],
  levels = cluster_order$cluster_label
)

cluster_cols_use <- cluster_cols[levels(neighborhoods$cluster)]


cluster_summary <- neighborhoods %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    n_regions = n(),
    avg_price = round(mean(median_price), 2),
    avg_sd = round(mean(sd_price), 2),
    avg_accommodates = round(mean(mean_accommodates), 2),
    avg_tv = round(mean(tv_rate), 2),
    avg_dishes = round(mean(dishes_rate), 2),
    avg_gym = round(mean(gym_rate), 2),
    avg_parking = round(mean(parking_rate), 2),
    avg_cooking = round(mean(cooking_rate), 2),
    avg_pets = round(mean(pets_rate), 2),
    avg_heating = round(mean(heating_rate), 2),
    avg_balcony = round(mean(balcony_rate), 2),
    avg_hotwater = round(mean(hotwater_rate), 2),
    avg_ac = round(mean(ac_rate), 2),
    avg_wifi = round(mean(wifi_rate), 2),
    avg_washer = round(mean(washer_rate), 2),
    avg_dryer = round(mean(dryer_rate), 2),
    avg_workspace = round(mean(workspace_rate), 2),
    avg_elevator = round(mean(elevator_rate), 2),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(cluster_summary)



p_elbow <- fviz_nbclust(pc_scores, kmeans, method = "wss") +
  labs(
    title = "Elbow method",
    subtitle = "Used to assess possible numbers of clusters",
    x = "Number of clusters (k)",
    y = "Within-cluster sum of squares"
  ) +
  theme_pro()

p_sil <- ggplot(sil_results, aes(x = k, y = avg_sil)) +
  geom_line(color = "#2563EB", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = "#2563EB") +
  labs(
    title = "Silhouette test",
    subtitle = "Higher values indicate better cluster separation",
    x = "Number of clusters (k)",
    y = "Average silhouette width"
  ) +
  theme_pro()

cluster_sizes <- neighborhoods %>%
  count(cluster)

p_size <- ggplot(cluster_sizes, aes(x = cluster, y = n, fill = cluster)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cluster_cols_use) +
  labs(
    title = "Cluster sizes",
    subtitle = "Balanced clusters are preferred",
    x = "Cluster",
    y = "Number of neighborhoods"
  ) +
  theme_pro()


p_pca <- bind_cols(neighborhoods, plot_scores) %>%
  ggplot(aes(PC1, PC2, color = cluster, size = median_price)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.92) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = region_wrapped),
    size = 3.1,
    max.overlaps = 35,
    box.padding = 0.45,
    min.segment.length = 0
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cluster_cols_use) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(3, 9), labels = scales::dollar_format()) +
  labs(
    title = "PCA scatter plot",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "PC1 explains ", percent(var_expl[1], accuracy = 0.1),
      "; PC2 explains ", percent(var_expl[2], accuracy = 0.1)
    ),
    x = "Principal Component 1",
    y = "Principal Component 2",
    color = "Cluster",
    size = "Median price"
  ) +
  theme_pro()



p_box <- ggplot(neighborhoods, aes(cluster, median_price, fill = cluster)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.9, outlier.alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.65, size = 2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cluster_cols_use) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = dollar_format()) +
  labs(
    title = "Median price by cluster",
    subtitle = "This shows whether the clusters differ meaningfully in price level",
    x = "Cluster",
    y = "Neighborhood median price"
  ) +
  theme_pro()



p_scatter_mean_median <- ggplot(
  neighborhoods,
  aes(mean_price, median_price, color = cluster, size = n_listings)
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.92) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = region_wrapped),
    size = 3,
    max.overlaps = 30,
    box.padding = 0.45,
    min.segment.length = 0
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cluster_cols_use) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(3, 8)) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = dollar_format()) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = dollar_format()) +
  labs(
    title = "Mean vs median price",
    subtitle = "Shows overall price structure by neighborhood",
    x = "Mean price",
    y = "Median price",
    color = "Cluster",
    size = "Listings"
  ) +
  theme_pro()

p_scatter_spread <- ggplot(
  neighborhoods,
  aes(median_price, sd_price, color = cluster, size = n_listings)
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.92) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = region_wrapped),
    size = 3,
    max.overlaps = 30,
    box.padding = 0.45,
    min.segment.length = 0
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cluster_cols_use) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(3, 8)) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = dollar_format()) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = dollar_format()) +
  labs(
    title = "Median price vs price spread",
    subtitle = "Higher points have more variable prices within the neighborhood",
    x = "Median price",
    y = "Standard deviation of price",
    color = "Cluster",
    size = "Listings"
  ) +
  theme_pro()



p_density <- ggplot(neighborhoods, aes(median_price, fill = cluster)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.35) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cluster_cols_use) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = dollar_format()) +
  labs(
    title = "Density of median prices by cluster",
    subtitle = "Used to check whether the price distributions overlap strongly",
    x = "Neighborhood median price",
    y = "Density",
    fill = "Cluster"
  ) +
  theme_pro()


profile_long <- neighborhoods %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    median_price = mean(median_price),
    sd_price = mean(sd_price),
    iqr_price = mean(iqr_price),
    mean_accommodates = mean(mean_accommodates),
    tv_rate = mean(tv_rate),
    dishes_rate = mean(dishes_rate),
    gym_rate = mean(gym_rate),
    parking_rate = mean(parking_rate),
    cooking_rate = mean(cooking_rate),
    pets_rate = mean(pets_rate),
    heating_rate = mean(heating_rate),
    balcony_rate = mean(balcony_rate),
    hotwater_rate = mean(hotwater_rate),
    ac_rate = mean(ac_rate),
    wifi_rate = mean(wifi_rate),
    washer_rate = mean(washer_rate),
    dryer_rate = mean(dryer_rate),
    workspace_rate = mean(workspace_rate),
    elevator_rate = mean(elevator_rate),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(-cluster, names_to = "feature", values_to = "value") %>%
  group_by(feature) %>%
  mutate(value_scaled = as.numeric(scale(value))) %>%
  ungroup()

p_profile <- ggplot(profile_long, aes(x = feature, y = value_scaled, group = cluster, color = cluster)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cluster_cols_use) +
  labs(
    title = "Cluster profiles",
    subtitle = "Scaled comparison of price, spread, accommodation, and selected amenities",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Scaled value",
    color = "Cluster"
  ) +
  theme_pro() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1))

pair_df <- neighborhoods %>%
  select(
    cluster,
    median_price,
    sd_price,
    iqr_price,
    mean_accommodates,
    parking_rate,
    gym_rate,
    wifi_rate
  ) %>%
  rename(
    `Median price` = median_price,
    `SD price` = sd_price,
    `IQR price` = iqr_price,
    `Accommodates` = mean_accommodates,
    `Parking rate` = parking_rate,
    `Gym rate` = gym_rate,
    `WiFi rate` = wifi_rate
  )

p_pair <- GGally::ggpairs(
  pair_df,
  columns = 2:6,
  ggplot2::aes(color = cluster, alpha = 0.8),
  upper = list(continuous = GGally::wrap("cor", size = 3.5)),
  lower = list(continuous = GGally::wrap("points", size = 1.6)),
  diag = list(continuous = GGally::wrap("densityDiag"))
) +
  ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 11)


dir.create("cluster_outputs_improved", showWarnings = FALSE)

write.csv(cluster_summary, "cluster_outputs_improved/cluster_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(neighborhoods, "cluster_outputs_improved/neighborhood_cluster_membership.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(sil_results, "cluster_outputs_improved/cluster_test_results.csv", row.names = FALSE)


save_plot_hi(
  p_elbow + p_sil + p_size + patchwork::plot_layout(ncol = 3),
  "cluster_outputs_improved/01_cluster_diagnostics.png",
  width = 17,
  height = 5.5
)

save_plot_hi(
  p_pca,
  "cluster_outputs_improved/02_pca_scatter.png",
  width = 12,
  height = 8
)

save_plot_hi(
  p_box,
  "cluster_outputs_improved/03_boxplot_median_price.png",
  width = 11,
  height = 7
)

save_plot_hi(
  p_scatter_mean_median,
  "cluster_outputs_improved/04_scatter_mean_vs_median.png",

  height = 8
)

save_plot_hi(
  p_scatter_spread,
  "cluster_outputs_improved/05_scatter_price_spread.png",
  width = 12,
  height = 8
)

save_plot_hi(
  p_density,
  "cluster_outputs_improved/06_density_plot.png",
  width = 12,
  height = 8
)

save_plot_hi(
  p_profile,
  "cluster_outputs_improved/07_cluster_profile_plot.png",
  width = 14,
  height = 8
)

ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = "cluster_outputs_improved/08_pair_plot.png",
  plot = p_pair,
  width = 14,
  height = 12,
  dpi = 400,
  bg = "white"
)


cat("\n====================================\n")
cat("CLUSTER TEST RESULTS\n")
cat("====================================\n")
print(sil_results)

cat("\n====================================\n")
cat("CHOSEN NUMBER OF CLUSTERS\n")
cat("====================================\n")
print(best_k)

cat("\n====================================\n")
cat("CLUSTER SUMMARY\n")
cat("====================================\n")
print(cluster_summary)

cat("\nSaved all outputs in folder: cluster_outputs_improved\n")

print(p_elbow + p_sil + p_size + patchwork::plot_layout(ncol = 3))
print(p_pca)
print(p_box)
print(p_scatter_mean_median)
print(p_scatter_spread)
print(p_density)
print(p_profile)
```

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)

new_data$city <- "Boston"
Jersey_data$city <- "Jersey City"


combined_data <- bind_rows(new_data, Jersey_data)

all_amenities <- sort(unique(unlist(combined_data$amenities)))

amenity_matrix <- t(sapply(combined_data$amenities, function(x) {
  as.numeric(all_amenities %in% x)
}))

colnames(amenity_matrix) <- all_amenities
amenity_matrix <- as.data.frame(amenity_matrix)

amenity_matrix <- amenity_matrix[, apply(amenity_matrix, 2, var) > 0]

pca_result <- prcomp(
  amenity_matrix,
  center = TRUE,
  scale. = TRUE
)



pca_df <- as.data.frame(pca_result$x)

pca_df$city <- combined_data$city
pca_df$price <- combined_data$price
pca_df$price_per_guest <- combined_data$price_per_guest


pca_var <- pca_result$sdev^2
pca_var_percent <- round(100 * pca_var / sum(pca_var), 1)


ggplot(pca_df, aes(PC1, PC2, color = city)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "PCA of Airbnb Listings (Boston vs Jersey City)",
    subtitle = "Comparison of listing structures based on amenities",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", pca_var_percent[1], "% variance)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", pca_var_percent[2], "% variance)")
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)



ggplot(pca_df, aes(PC1, PC2, color = price)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
  scale_color_viridis_c() +
  labs(
    title = "PCA of Listings Colored by Price",
    subtitle = "Shows how amenities relate to pricing structure"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


set.seed(123)

clusters <- kmeans(scale(amenity_matrix), centers = 4, nstart = 25)
pca_df$cluster <- as.factor(clusters$cluster)

ggplot(pca_df, aes(PC1, PC2, color = cluster)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(
    title = "Amenity-Based Clusters Across Cities",
    subtitle = "Segments of Airbnb listings"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


scree_df <- data.frame(
  PC = paste0("PC", 1:length(pca_var_percent)),
  Variance = pca_var_percent
)

ggplot(scree_df[1:10, ], aes(x = PC, y = Variance)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  labs(
    title = "Scree Plot",
    y = "Variance Explained (%)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
